title: Open Plugin Market
license: GPL-3.0 source catalog; plugin licenses remain separate

description.en: Community plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件索引。

description.en: ★ 5,866 │ Provide Bash, PowerShell 7 and Rust-based command tools for DSH on Windows.
description.zh: ★ 5,866 │ 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 Bash、PowerShell 7 和 Rust 命令工具。

description.en: ★ 5,192 │ Keep files, an editor, changes, tasks and side chat together in a per-conversation sidebar.
description.zh: ★ 5,192 │ 在每个会话的侧栏中查看文件、编辑器、变更、任务与旁聊。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Bring the Shorekeeper from Wuthering Waves to your desktop with task expressions, voices and customizable media. Requires Windows 10/11 x64, local DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0 and Node >=22. First use downloads a separate ~229 MiB application; program updates validate a publisher-signed manifest.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 把《鸣潮》的守岸人带到桌面，以任务表情、语音和可自定义素材陪伴工作。需 Windows 10/11 x64、本机 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0、Node >=22；首次另行下载约 229 MiB 程序，程序更新校验发布者签名清单。

description.en: ★ 724 │ Lay out the sessions, follow-ups and forks of a workspace as a draggable, zoomable map, keeping native DSH sessions as the only source of truth.
description.zh: ★ 724 │ 把同一工作区的会话、追问和分支排成可拖拽、可缩放的地图，DSH 原生会话仍是唯一的数据来源。

description.en: ★ 198 │ DSH Web UI plugin: automatically sends a localized continue prompt when a request is interrupted by network errors or other non-human causes
description.zh: ★ 198 │ 在网络错误等非人工中断后自动发送继续提示。

description.en: ★ 10 │ DeepSeek design specification: unifies the Harness interface language, with targeted adaptation for community plugins and a read-only compatibility audit.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 统一 DSH 的界面样式，适配社区插件，并提供只读兼容性检查。

description.en: ★ 2,891 │ Share Markdown memory across coding agents, with automatic capture, retrieval and review of skill candidates.
description.zh: ★ 2,891 │ 在多个编程 Agent 间共享 Markdown 记忆，支持自动记录、检索和技能候选审阅。

description.en: ★ 547 │ Download invoice attachments from QQ or 163 mail over IMAP, run OCR locally, file them by rule and produce an Excel summary. Requires Python 3.10+ on Windows x64 or Apple Silicon.
description.zh: ★ 547 │ 通过 IMAP 从 QQ 或 163 邮箱下载发票附件，本地 OCR 识别后按规则归档，并生成 Excel 汇总。需要 Python 3.10+，支持 Windows x64 和 Apple Silicon。

description.en: ★ 404 │ Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
description.zh: ★ 404 │ 通过原生适配器为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Zen 模型。

description.en: ★ 10 │ DSH Cordis plugin: hooks the core model-request seam (agent/pre-step and agent/request) to force-compact a session's context and disable thinking per the 强制压缩配置 settings namespace.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 在模型请求前按设置强制压缩上下文，并可关闭模型思考。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Check and update local applications on Windows with winget and macOS with Homebrew. Downloads and installs software; administrator approval may be required. Keep the optional legacy loopback mode disabled unless needed.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 检查并更新本机应用，Windows 使用 winget，macOS 更新需 Homebrew。会下载和安装软件，可能触发管理员授权；旧宿主回环兼容模式建议保持关闭。

description.en: ★ 73 │ Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (memory palace · AGI Architecture Exploration on dsh-market): dual-scope SQLite memory graph, hybrid retrieval, provenance audit, and a knowledge flywheel.
description.zh: ★ 73 │ 用 SQLite 记忆图、混合检索和来源记录保存跨会话知识。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Manage streamable HTTP and stdio MCP servers from DSH settings, configure request headers, test connectivity and enable or disable individual tools.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在 DSH 设置中管理 streamable HTTP 与 stdio MCP 服务器，配置请求头、测试连接，并逐个启停工具。

description.en: ★ 33 │ Add a Monaco editor and review agent edits with per-change acceptance, rejection and rollback.
description.zh: ★ 33 │ 提供 Monaco 文件编辑器，逐处审查、采纳或拒绝 Agent 修改，并支持回滚。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Browse Bilibili recommendations, watch videos with danmaku, and optionally sync watch progress from a sidebar. QR login stores account cookies on the local host and sends them to Bilibili; no model calls. Requires Node >=20; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧边栏浏览 B 站推荐、观看视频与弹幕，可选同步观看进度。扫码登录将账号 Cookie 保存在本机并用于 B 站请求，不调用模型。需 Node >=20；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 5,195 │ Inspect context composition, changes and compression from a dashboard and command.
description.zh: ★ 5,195 │ 通过面板和命令查看上下文组成、变化与压缩情况。

description.en: ★ 1,681 │ Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models and view account credits.
description.zh: ★ 1,681 │ 接入本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 模型，并查看账户积分。

description.en: ★ 6,372 │ A lazy blue fish living in DeepSeek Harness: plays with a Rubik's cube, snacks, naps, roams the desktop, tracks your balance wallet, and chats when idle.
description.zh: ★ 6,372 │ 在 DSH 中添加蓝色鱼形桌宠，会玩魔方、吃零食、打盹和聊天，并显示账户余额。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Run board or list tasks through DSH sessions and sync their status in host-side storage.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过 DSH 会话执行看板或清单中的任务，把状态回写到宿主端共享存储。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect the local lot-trader ledger to DSH: six read tools and five write tools (buy, add, close, dividend, account) with host approval for every write, plus a sidebar position board. On first use it downloads the trade engine from the author’s GitHub Releases and installs it only if the SHA-256 matches. Records trades; it does not place orders.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把本机 lot-trader 操盘账本接入 DSH：6 个读工具、5 个写工具（买入、加仓、平仓、记分红、建账户），写操作都走宿主审批，侧栏提供持仓看板。首次使用会从作者 GitHub Releases 下载 trade 引擎，SHA-256 校验通过才安装。只记账，不下单。

description.en: ★ 6 │ DeepSeek Harness bundle: the read_document tool reads Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files as Markdown for the model
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 将 Word、PPT、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 转为模型可读的 Markdown。

description.en: ★ 2,151 │ Control Blender scenes, modeling and rendering with Python. Tested on Blender 4.2 LTS; GUI mode needs the bundled addon. The loopback execution bridge currently has no authentication.
description.zh: ★ 2,151 │ 通过 Python 操控 Blender 场景、建模和渲染。已测试 Blender 4.2 LTS，图形模式需安装配套 addon；本机执行桥接目前无认证。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: SSH remote ops and dev toolkit (run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull), ControlMaster connection layer, status panel, and host management in Settings.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 SSH 执行远程命令和文件读写、搜索、传输，在设置中管理主机与连接状态。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show DeepSeek account balance as a whale-shaped water level, with spending history and low-balance reminders.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用鲸鱼水位显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，悬停查看消耗记录与低余额提醒。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Map and routing tools for DeepSeek Harness: driving, transit, walking, and cycling route planning, geocoding, reverse geocoding, and POI search via Amap (高德) or free OSM/OSRM.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 通过高德或 OSM/OSRM 查询地点，规划驾车、公交、步行和骑行路线。

description.en: ★ 46 │ Combine a calendar, hierarchical tasks, AI planning, execution reviews and desktop reminders.
description.zh: ★ 46 │ 组合日历、分层任务、AI 拆解、执行复盘与桌面提醒。

description.en: ★ 45 │ A multi-character Galgame interface and optional desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: ★ 45 │ 为网页会话添加多角色 Galgame 互动界面，感知其他会话的任务事件，并提供可选桌面伴侣。

description.en: ★ 561 │ Search evidence-rated failure lessons through the public MisakaNet MCP service.
description.zh: ★ 561 │ 通过 MisakaNet 公共 MCP 服务，检索附有证据评级的失败案例和经验。

description.en: ★ 7,272 │ Show account balance and per-turn usage in a customizable animated whale widget.
description.zh: ★ 7,272 │ 用可自定义的鲸鱼挂件显示账户余额与每轮用量。

description.en: ★ 235 │ Cross-session memory for AI agents: distilled into a local SQLite store with readable Markdown mirrors, recalled on demand, consolidated while idle. Trace any memory back to its source session; optional affective and image memory; extend via HTTP API or MCP.
description.zh: ★ 235 │ 跨会话记忆：提炼进本机 SQLite 正本 + 可读 Markdown 镜像，按需召回、空闲巩固。每条记忆可回溯到来源会话；可选情感记忆与图像记忆；可通过 HTTP API / MCP 让其他插件自行扩展。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Personalization settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加个性化设置。

description.en: ★ 370 │ Search DBLP and arXiv, retrieve BibTeX citations and access available paper full text.
description.zh: ★ 370 │ 检索 DBLP 和 arXiv，获取 BibTeX 引用及可用的论文全文。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek account balance and per-session usage cost in the Harness composer dock.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框旁显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和各会话费用。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Local long-term memory with 15 MCP tools, automatic capture and recall, and bounded pointer context. Shares stored user input across sessions. Requires Node >=20, Python >=3.10, torch, sentence-transformers, numpy and mcp >=1.30 <2; first use downloads an embedding model. No DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 提供 15 个 MCP 长期记忆工具、自动捕获召回和有界指针上下文；用户输入会持久保存并跨会话共享。需 Node >=20、Python >=3.10，以及 torch、sentence-transformers、numpy、mcp >=1.30 <2，首次会下载嵌入模型；包内未声明 DSH 版本范围。

description.en: ★ 71 │ Agent toolkit that helps coding agents use Huawei Cloud Skills, KooCLI, APIs, SDKs, and future MCP capabilities safely and accurately.
description.zh: ★ 71 │ 在编程会话中使用华为云技能、KooCLI、API 与 SDK。

description.en: ★ 50 │ Show session progress, token usage and costs through a whale-girl companion and task bubbles.
description.zh: ★ 50 │ 用角色状态与任务气泡展示会话进度、Token 用量和费用。

description.en: ★ 123 │ Run a session's shell and file tools inside a selected WSL distribution.
description.zh: ★ 123 │ 在选定的 WSL 发行版中运行会话命令与文件工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Ark models, web-search tools and Web UI in one bundle
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在一个插件包中接入方舟模型、网页搜索和配套界面。

description.en: ★ 47 │ Control OriginLab data import, scientific plot templates and figure edits through MCP tools.
description.zh: ★ 47 │ 通过 MCP 工具操作 OriginLab 数据导入、科研图模板与图表编辑。

description.en: ★ 1 │ DeepSeek Harness (dsh) settings cards and conversation node plugin.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 提供设置卡片和会话节点组件。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Adjust conversation, interface, and code typography and save, import, or export presets.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 分别调整对话、界面和代码的字体样式，并保存、导入和导出排版预设。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Play five built-in games and install community games while following agent status, with saved progress and completion reminders. Community catalogs and game packages are downloaded; games run in isolated frames with instance credentials. Requires DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0 and Node >=20.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 Agent 工作时游玩五款内置游戏或安装社区游戏，保留进度并显示任务状态与完成提醒。社区目录和游戏包需联网下载，游戏在隔离框架中运行并使用实例凭证。需 DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0、Node >=20。

description.en: ★ 10,458 │ Browse branch history and run workspace Git operations from the web interface.
description.zh: ★ 10,458 │ 在网页界面查看分支历史，并操作工作区 Git 仓库。

description.en: ★ 1 │ A skills, tools and prompt-budget HUD: see what this session loaded, what it costs, and what can be parked. All plugin routes go through host connection.admit() / requestRejection(); if the connection service is missing the plugin fails closed with 503 and does not fall back to loopback. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 and Node >=22.23.4.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 技能、工具与提示词预算面板：查看本会话实际加载了什么、开销以及哪些可以暂搁。全部接口走宿主 connection.admit() / requestRejection()；认证服务缺失时以 503 拒绝，不再按回环地址放行。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5、Node >=22.23.4。

description.en: ★ 318 │ Import AI coding agent conversations as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: ★ 318 │ 将 AI 编程助手聊天记录导入为可继续对话的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

title.zh: DSH 插件 Git 同步

description.en: ★ 1 │ Back up, restore and synchronize plugin inventories and deployed skills through your own Git repository, with snapshots and conflict handling. Requires Git and repository access; synchronization can install plugins and update skill files. Plugin configuration values are excluded from backup. Requires Node >=22.19.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并同步插件清单与已部署技能，支持快照和冲突处理。需 Git 与仓库访问权限；同步可安装插件、更新技能文件，备份不包含插件配置值。需 Node >=22.19。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Type /telleru in a conversation and an AI teacher writes and talks on a right-hand whiteboard. Routes go through the host connection.fetch API. Optional TellerU token and Doubao speech key stay in plugin settings. License is the bundled Terms of Use (free to install and use; modification and redistribution require permission). About 20 MB unpacked (app, fonts). Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 and Node >=22.19.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在对话中输入 /telleru，AI 老师在右侧白板边写边讲。接口走宿主 connection.fetch。可选的 TellerU 令牌和豆包语音密钥保存在插件设置中。许可为随包使用条款（可免费安装使用，修改与再分发需书面许可）。解压约 20 MB（含应用与字体）。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3、Node >=22.19。

description.en: ★ 113 │ fnOS-specific integrations for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 113 │ 为 DSH 提供 fnOS 专用集成。

description.en: ★ 27 │ Fail-closed password authentication proxy bundle for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile
description.zh: ★ 27 │ 为 DSH 网页配置提供密码认证代理。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Open the native slash-command menu by typing the Chinese enumeration comma 、 at the start of the input. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 在输入框行首输入顿号「、」即可唤出原生斜杠命令菜单。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Edit or delete a sent message and roll back the following turns, optionally restoring file changes recorded in that span. File restores stay inside the workspace; routes use DSH host authentication. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 编辑或删除已发送的消息并回滚其后的对话，可选择同时还原这段对话记录的文件改动。文件还原限制在工作区内，接口使用 DSH 宿主认证。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Shows the DeepSeek API balance and this conversation's spend in the Harness web UI: a persistent balance pill beside the composer, with details on hover.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在输入框旁显示 DeepSeek API 余额与当前会话费用，悬停查看明细。

title.zh: Modern Web Guidance · 现代 Web 指南

description.en: ★ 3 │ Search and retrieve 208 offline web-platform guides, scan workspace files for legacy patterns, and use Modern Web Guidance and Chrome Extensions skills. Includes local usage and scan history; requires Node >=22.19.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 离线搜索、读取 208 篇 Web 平台指南，扫描工作区中的旧式写法，并提供 Modern Web Guidance 与 Chrome Extensions 技能。附本地用量和扫描历史；需 Node >=22.19。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Codex-style streaming, thinking blocks, tool activity, and deliverable previews.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 提供 Codex 风格的流式回复、思考内容、工具活动和产物预览。

description.en: ★ 287 │ Connect steps on a canvas and compile the graph into a dispatch plan for the model to execute.
description.zh: ★ 287 │ 在画布中连接步骤，将流程转换为模型可执行的任务计划。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Use PackyCode API keys in DeepSeek Harness, with multi-protocol models, image generation and editing, separate key rings, and balance display.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 通过 PackyCode API 接入多协议模型和图片生成、编辑工具，管理密钥与余额。

description.en: ★ 3,652 │ Connects WeChat, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, and Matrix to DSH.
description.zh: ★ 3,652 │ 将微信、飞书、企微、钉钉、QQ、Telegram、WhatsApp、Slack、Discord、Matrix 接入 DSH。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Track todo creation and completion times in table, board, Gantt and calendar views, with workspace file references, a /todo command and an agent tool. Data stays in local JSON; requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.3-0.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 记录待办创建与完成时间，通过表格、看板、甘特图和日历查看，支持工作区文件引用、/todo 命令和 Agent 工具。数据保存在本地 JSON，需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.3-0。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Manage skills, MCP servers, instruction files, custom commands and hooks from the DSH Plugins page. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在 DSH 插件页管理 Skill、MCP 服务器、指令文件、自定义命令和 Hooks。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: ★ 707 │ Track session and daily model costs alongside account balances, budgets, and subscription usage.
description.zh: ★ 707 │ 统计会话与每日模型费用，显示账户余额、预算和订阅套餐用量。

description.en: ★ 65 │ Send notifications through 28 outbound channels and handle approvals, questions and session control from your phone through 6 inbound channels.
description.zh: ★ 65 │ 通过 28 个出站渠道推送通知，并经 6 个入站渠道在手机上处理审批、回答提问和控制会话。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Record runtime failures and coding retrospectives locally, explore a WebGL knowledge graph and recall lessons through tools and optional context injection. The panel API accepts local connections only; the package declares no DSH version range.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在本地记录运行错误与编程复盘，以 WebGL 图谱查看关联，通过工具和可关闭的上下文注入复用教训。面板接口仅接受本机连接，包内未声明适用的 DSH 版本。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 压缩工具输出并保留恢复能力，结合缓存状态压缩上下文。

description.en: ★ 11 │ Generate images, video, music and speech through multiple providers, with transcription and visual analysis tools.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 接入多家供应商生成图片、视频、音乐和语音，并提供转写与视觉分析工具。

description.en: ★ 44 │ Browse and toggle skills, diagnose metadata problems, and import or track updates from repositories.
description.zh: ★ 44 │ 在设置页浏览和开关技能，检查格式问题，并从仓库导入及跟踪更新。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Publish generated HTML or Markdown to GitHub Pages and manage previously published artifacts.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将生成的 HTML 或 Markdown 发布到 GitHub Pages，并管理已发布产物。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Zoom individual web panels with Ctrl+wheel or keyboard shortcuts and reset each panel independently.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 Ctrl 加滚轮或快捷键独立缩放网页面板，并分别恢复默认大小。

description.en: ★ 6,418 │ Create and edit local design canvases. Requires dsh-claude-artifacts; online fonts need network access.
description.zh: ★ 6,418 │ 制作、编辑本地设计画布；需 dsh-claude-artifacts，在线字体需联网。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Remote development launcher: install dsh on a remote host and use it in your local browser, with credentials staying on this machine.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 在远程主机安装 DSH，通过本机浏览器访问，登录凭据保留在本机。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Rewrite prompts and extract template variables with a selected DSH model. Preview, copy or apply the result to the draft; model calls can incur API fees. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-0 and Node >=18; history is saved in browser storage when enabled.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 使用所选 DSH 模型润色提示词、提取模板变量，支持预览、复制和写回草稿。模型调用可能产生费用；需 DSH ≥0.1.7-0、Node ≥18，启用历史后保存在浏览器中。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a full sidebar page with focus, short-break, and long-break cycles, plus a countdown pill beside the composer.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供专注、短休息和长休息计时，在侧栏及输入框旁显示倒计时。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Add file browsing, Monaco editing, search and local Git controls to DSH.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在 DSH 中提供文件浏览、Monaco 编辑器、搜索和本地 Git 操作面板。

description.en: ★ 45 │ Develop Minecraft server plugins and mods with version-aware skills and a Gradle runner.
description.zh: ★ 45 │ 使用区分版本的技能与 Gradle 工具开发 Minecraft 插件和模组。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add an editable one-click send button beside the composer. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框旁添加可编辑文字的一键发送按钮。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 531 │ Browse, search and install community plugins inside DSH.
description.zh: ★ 531 │ 在 DSH 中浏览、搜索并安装社区插件。

description.en: ★ 26 │ Adjust reasoning effort automatically for each tool round, with an optional manual lock and per-tool timing.
description.zh: ★ 26 │ 按每轮工具调用自动调整推理强度，也可以手动锁定档位，并记录各工具的耗时。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Unified subscription providers and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ DeepSeek Harness 的统一订阅供应商与用量看板。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Open an OpenBMC web console from DSH settings through an SSH-forwarded same-origin proxy that follows BMC IP changes. Requires an SSH jump host that can reach the BMC.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH 设置里经 SSH 转发的同源代理打开 OpenBMC 网页控制台，BMC IP 变化时自动重新连接。需要能访问 BMC 的 SSH 跳板机。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Let the Agent read, click, type, scroll, capture and batch actions in the built-in sidebar browser. Requires DSH Desktop with its Electron webview; supports local file pages and page JavaScript, and uses the browser’s signed-in sessions.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 让 Agent 在内置侧栏浏览器读取页面、点击、输入、滚动、截图并批量操作。需带 Electron webview 的 DSH 桌面版，支持本机文件页面和页面 JavaScript，会使用浏览器已有登录状态。

description.en: ★ 37 │ Turn material into an HTML slideshow, an editable PPTX and a project file, with charts, light editing, undo and quality checks. Final PPTX rendering can use LibreOffice.
description.zh: ★ 37 │ 把材料做成 HTML 放映稿、可编辑的 PPTX 和工程文件，支持图表、轻量编辑、撤销与质量检查。最终 PPTX 渲染可选用 LibreOffice。

description.en: ★ 561 │ Turn local or online video into timestamped storyboard sheets, with scene cuts, subtitles, OCR and optional transcription. Requires FFmpeg/ffprobe; sites may need yt-dlp, and OCR or transcription need their own environment or service.
description.zh: ★ 561 │ 将本地或在线视频整理为带时间码的分镜图，支持镜头切分、字幕、OCR 及可选语音转写。需准备 FFmpeg/ffprobe；站点下载可能需要 yt-dlp，OCR 和转写需另配运行环境或服务。

description.en: ★ 60 │ Configure speech engines such as Edge TTS and read messages manually or automatically.
description.zh: ★ 60 │ 配置 Edge TTS 等语音引擎，手动或自动朗读消息。

description.en: ★ 14 │ Side Chat Plus lets you select conversation text and ask about it in a per-session side chat. It is a hidden session with its own right panel that inherits model, effort, and permissions.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 选中文字后在独立侧边会话中追问，沿用主会话的模型、思考强度和权限。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Exposes DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web capabilities to the Xiaozhi voice assistant over MCP, as a self-contained bundle that registers DSH as an MCP tool provider and supports multiple devices.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过 MCP 将 DSH 工具接给小智语音助手，支持多个设备。

description.en: ★ 487 │ Register Command Code models and a provider configuration card in DSH.
description.zh: ★ 487 │ 在 DSH 中注册 Command Code 模型与供应商配置卡片。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Media library for the dsh web UI: browse configured local directories as a grid or list, open images in a viewer, and play videos in a page-fullscreen player with swipe navigation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 以网格或列表浏览本地媒体目录，查看图片，或全屏播放和滑动切换视频。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Hear what the agent is doing: generative background music while the model writes, plus adjustable cues for thinking, answering, tool runs, completion and waiting. Sounds are synthesized in the browser.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用声音盯住 Agent：模型输出时播放生成式背景音乐，思考、回答、工具执行以及完成、等待的提示音可分别调节。声音由浏览器实时合成。

description.en: ★ 49 │ Inspect token costs, cache-hit breakdowns and cumulative spending curves.
description.zh: ★ 49 │ 查看 Token 费用、缓存命中明细与累计花费曲线。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Browse, search, and install SkillHub skills inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索并安装 SkillHub 技能。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Scheduled, unattended novel writing and Fanqie publishing for Windows x64. First use downloads a separate ~278 MB runtime from the author GitHub Release and verifies SHA-256 and size before extract. The bundled writer is GPL v3; other components are MIT or their upstream licenses (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). This is a prerelease (0.2.0-rc.1). Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 面向 Windows x64 的定时、无人值守小说写作与番茄发布。首次使用会从作者 GitHub Release 另行下载约 278 MB 运行环境，解压前校验 SHA-256 与大小。随包写作器为 GPL v3，其余组件为 MIT 或各自上游许可（见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md）。当前是预发布版 0.2.0-rc.1。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 542 │ Aggregate accounts and provider models, inspect usage, and configure routing and a local gateway.
description.zh: ★ 542 │ 汇总多个账号和供应商的模型，查看用量、设置路由，并提供本机模型网关。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Qwen chat, embeddings, reranking, speech and images through DashScope. Requires the AI Providers runtime and a regional API key; usage may incur fees.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过 DashScope 提供千问对话、嵌入、重排、语音和图像能力。需启用 AI Providers runtime 并配置对应地域 API 密钥，调用可能收费。

title.zh: 赛博小庙 · 每日运势

description.en: ★ 0 │ Draw a daily fortune in a small temple overlay, track check-in streaks and export shareable cards. Calendar calculations and state stay in the browser; requires the DSH web UI.

description.en: ★ 6 │ DSH web input enhancements: configurable send and newline keys, right-click menu, quick prompts stored in ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json, and prompt optimization with draft comparison.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 调整发送与换行按键，提供右键菜单、快捷提示词和带草稿对比的提示词优化。

description.zh: ★ 869 │ 通过局域网或可选的远程通道（Tailscale、cpolar、cloudflared、FRP），用手机浏览器或 Android App 安全地使用电脑上的 DSH，支持 HTTPS 和设备配对。

description.en: ★ 193 │ Adapt the web interface for portrait screens and mobile devices.
description.zh: ★ 193 │ 为竖屏和移动设备调整网页界面布局。

description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用 Zvec 对工作区建立语义索引并搜索，提供本地向量模型配置和调用规则。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Parse motor design requirements and filter candidate parameters for downstream calculation tools.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 解析电机设计需求，初筛候选参数并生成后续计算工具所需数据。

description.zh: ★ 75,309 │ 通过另行安装的 Mole CLI 查看 macOS 或 Windows 的磁盘占用和系统状态，预览清理并删除用户同意的项目。安装及破坏性清理均需用户授权。

description.en: ★ 2,979 │ Coordinate agent teams with task dependencies, direct messaging and a web monitor.
description.zh: ★ 2,979 │ 通过任务依赖、直接消息与网页监视器协调 Agent 团队。

description.en: ★ 70 │ Use skills to guide engineering tasks through the harness and agent loop.
description.zh: ★ 70 │ 通过技能组织工程任务，协调 DSH 与 Agent 的执行流程。

description.en: ★ 3,119 │ Apply a black-whale theme with square corners, straight-line icons and light and dark palettes.
description.zh: ★ 3,119 │ 提供黑鲸主题、直角界面、线条图标及明暗配色。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Adds thinking levels to third-party models in DSH, with a Thinking toggle and intensity/modality editor on the Models page and a provider-to-model picker in the composer. It also takes over request headers and user-agent per route.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 为第三方模型设置思考强度和图片输入，可按模型配置请求头与 User-Agent。

description.en: ★ 18 │ Edit the user-global AGENTS.md ($DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md) from the web settings panel.
description.zh: ★ 18 │ 在网页设置面板中编辑用户全局的 AGENTS.md（$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md）。

description.en: ★ 33 │ Use C/C++ firmware skills covering RTOS, interrupts, storage, debugging and architecture.
description.zh: ★ 33 │ 使用涵盖实时系统、中断、存储、调试和架构的 C/C++ 固件开发技能。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Track running and completed sessions in a searchable task panel with persistent unread status, sound and browser notifications. macOS also supports system notifications; browser notifications require permission. Author-tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在任务面板中搜索与筛选运行中、已完成会话，保留未读状态，并提供声音和浏览器通知。macOS 另支持系统通知，浏览器通知需授权；作者验证环境为 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Git tools and /git slash commands for DeepSeek Harness, running git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work even when the session shell is sandboxed.

description.en: ★ 0 │ Control built-in and plugin tools and customize the system prompt. Chat mode replaces the host prompt and can ask for approval before web calls; requires Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 管理内置及插件工具的开关和系统提示词。聊天模式会替换宿主提示词，可在网络调用前请求授权；需要 Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Control Windows apps through window targets, UI Automation, screenshots and verified input, with an isolated Chromium option.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过窗口定位、UI Automation、截图和输入检查操作 Windows 应用，可使用独立 Chromium 实例。

description.zh: ★ 233 │ 按运行阶段显示可编辑文案、主题与状态栏动画。

description.zh: ★ 1,281 │ 将图片问题路由到视觉供应商，并提供 OCR、定位与像素比较工具。

description.en: ★ 57 │ Drive remote servers from the conversation: interactive terminal, SFTP file management, port forwarding and database management.
description.zh: ★ 57 │ 在会话中操作远程服务器，使用终端、SFTP 文件管理、端口转发和数据库工具。

description.zh: ★ 5 │ 把 Markdown 排成带内联样式的公众号文章，提供主题、侧边工作台和块级改稿工具。

description.zh: ★ 496 │ 通过 OAuth 接入 ChatGPT 与 Codex 订阅模型，并查看账户额度。

description.zh: ★ 112 │ 为网页端和桌面端设置本地图片或视频背景。

Supports remote commands, approvals and cross-machine tools; file writing, Shell and management permissions are disabled by default. Uses a generated access token, paired device credentials and optional network relays.

description.zh: ★ 7,193 │ 在 DSH 界面使用本机 Wallpaper Engine 场景、网页与视频壁纸。

description.en: ★ 3,000 │ Pair a phone with desktop DSH over LAN or a public connection to follow the same session.

Uses Google OAuth with a local loopback callback; files and metadata come from the Google Drive API, and service-account setup can optionally use gcloud. Requires DSH >=0.2.0.
