description.zh: ★ 331 │ 浏览和管理 DSH 原生主题皮肤。

description.en: ★ 249 │ Connect locally signed-in Trae models with separate domestic and international providers.
description.zh: ★ 249 │ 接入本机已登录的 Trae 模型，分别管理国内与国际供应商。

description.en: ★ 71 │ Access DSH sessions, files and approvals from the AI-HUB mobile app through paired LAN access or a configured relay. Includes permanent cleanup of archived sessions. Keep DSH Web on loopback: binding it directly to a private network trusts clients on that network. Mobile apps and native helpers are separate components.
description.zh: ★ 71 │ 通过 AI-HUB 手机 App，以局域网配对或配置的中转连接 DSH 会话、文件与审批，包含永久清理已归档会话的工具。DSH Web 应保持回环监听；直接绑定私网时会信任同网直连客户端。手机 App 和原生辅助程序为独立组件。

description.en: ★ 1,580 │ Connect image-generation providers and local ComfyUI to the conversation.
description.zh: ★ 1,580 │ 在会话中接入多家图片生成供应商与本地 ComfyUI。

description.en: ★ 4,998 │ Add image understanding for text-only models through a separate vision provider.
description.zh: ★ 4,998 │ 通过独立视觉供应商为纯文本模型提供图片理解。

description.en: ★ 701 │ Organize evidence-backed research as a browsable domain ontology.
description.zh: ★ 701 │ 将有证据支持的研究整理为可浏览的领域本体。

description.en: ★ 1,165 │ Manage CloudBase databases, storage, authentication and application deployment from DSH.
description.zh: ★ 1,165 │ 在 DSH 中管理 CloudBase 数据库、存储、身份认证与应用部署。

description.en: ★ 1,047 │ Organize media projects and assets, then run TongFlow image, voice, music and video workflows on an embedded canvas.
description.zh: ★ 1,047 │ 按项目整理媒体素材，在内嵌画布中运行 TongFlow 图片、配音、音乐和视频流程。

description.en: ★ 114 │ Turn DSH sessions into a project board with task tracking, acceptance review and quick chat. Automatic scanning and AI analysis are enabled by default: session excerpts go to the selected model and can incur charges. Requires Node >=22.19 and an authenticated owner session; macOS desktop was tested by the author.
description.zh: ★ 114 │ 将 DSH 会话整理为项目看板，支持任务跟踪、验收与快聊。默认开启自动扫描和 AI 分析，会将会话摘录发给所选模型并可能产生费用。需 Node >=22.19 和已认证的宿主所有者会话；作者验证了 macOS 桌面版。

description.en: ★ 156 │ Node-based short-drama studio for DeepSeek Harness: script → storyboard → assets → shots → voiced, subtitled final cut on an infinite canvas.
description.zh: ★ 156 │ 在无限画布中编写剧本、整理分镜与素材，制作带配音和字幕的短剧。

description.en: ★ 281 │ Rewrite a composer draft before sending with the current or a chosen model. Can include recent context and optional images; consumes model tokens and leaves the final edit and send to you.
description.zh: ★ 281 │ 使用当前或指定模型，在发送前原地改写输入框草稿，可参考近期上下文并按需带入图片。会消耗模型额度，改写后由你编辑和发送。

description.en: ★ 207 │ Curated long-term memory kept as plain Markdown notes and shared across hosts, with the index size limit enforced by a tool guard. Keep the store git-ignored when it sits inside a project repository.
description.zh: ★ 207 │ 以纯 Markdown 笔记保存的策展式长期记忆，多个宿主共用一个记忆库，索引上限由工具守卫强制执行。记忆库放在项目仓库内时需加入 git-ignore。

description.en: ★ 206 │ DSH undo/rollback system: snapshot config files on change, undo/redo the last action from the WebUI or by chat, and roll back broken plugin trees without reinstalling. Works even when DSH fails to boot (offline CLI + GUI).
description.zh: ★ 206 │ 为配置变更保存快照，支持撤销、重做和恢复损坏的插件配置；DSH 无法启动时也可离线恢复。

description.en: ★ 1,279 │ Search and fetch pages through multiple engines with configurable routing, filters and fallbacks.
description.zh: ★ 1,279 │ 使用多个引擎搜索和抓取网页，自定义路由、筛选与失败切换。

description.en: ★ 88 │ Apply Catppuccin color schemes and an optional translucent web skin.
description.zh: ★ 88 │ 应用 Catppuccin 配色与可选的半透明网页皮肤。

description.en: ★ 78 │ Search a local Zotero library, read notes and annotations, extract evidence, and generate citations.
description.zh: ★ 78 │ 检索本地 Zotero 文献库，读取笔记和标注，提取证据并生成引用。

description.en: ★ 86 │ Access sessions, approvals and files from mobile clients through a token gateway, with server switching and offline chat caching.
description.zh: ★ 86 │ 通过令牌网关从移动客户端访问会话、审批和文件，支持服务器切换及聊天离线缓存。

description.en: ★ 56 │ Run a dedicated Git Bash executor and terminal integration on Windows.
description.zh: ★ 56 │ 在 Windows 上使用独立 Git Bash 命令执行器与终端集成。

description.en: ★ 133 │ Recall and re-edit messages in the web conversation.
description.zh: ★ 133 │ 撤回并重新编辑网页会话中的消息。

description.en: ★ 47 │ Connect multiple mail accounts to send, receive, and search messages with attachments, drafts, and sending approvals.
description.zh: ★ 47 │ 连接多个邮箱，在会话中收发和搜索邮件，并管理附件、本地草稿与发信审批。

description.en: ★ 99 │ DSH provider plugin for Codex access through a ChatGPT subscription.
description.zh: ★ 99 │ 通过 ChatGPT 订阅在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型。

description.en: ★ 60 │ One settings panel for MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and archived sessions, with custom scenarios that switch the whole setup at once. The agent can also operate this plugin.
description.zh: ★ 60 │ 在一个面板管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子 Agent、提示词和归档会话，并按场景整体切换配置。

description.en: ★ 45 │ Search archived chats, restore conversations and delete sessions safely.
description.zh: ★ 45 │ 搜索已归档的聊天、恢复会话，并安全地删除会话。

description.en: ★ 55 │ Restore the conversation and workspace before a sent message, then edit and resend it.
description.zh: ★ 55 │ 将会话和工作区恢复到消息发送前，再编辑并重发消息。

description.en: ★ 32 │ Keep cross-session memories in local Markdown files and retrieve relevant content for context injection.
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 将跨会话记忆保存为本地 Markdown 文件，按问题检索并注入相关内容。

description.en: ★ 113 │ Hosts a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that exposes every model configured in DSH to Midscene browser automation. Midscene can drive pages in natural language without holding any credential itself.
description.zh: ★ 113 │ 在本机建立兼容 OpenAI 的桥接服务，让 Midscene 使用 DSH 模型进行浏览器自动化，凭据由桥接端处理。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness in a single package: JSONL storage, local vector search (BGE-M3), four model tools, automatic recall injection, and a management panel.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 用本地 JSONL 和 BGE-M3 向量检索保存长期记忆，支持自动召回和面板管理。

description.en: ★ 33 │ Provide streaming dictation, optional wake words, spoken replies, live captions and interruption when the user speaks.
description.zh: ★ 33 │ 提供流式听写、可选唤醒词、回复朗读与实时字幕，用户开口时可打断播放。

description.en: ★ 15 │ A read-only board over task-ledger workspaces, with the task-ledger skill bundled for global use.
description.zh: ★ 15 │ 只读查看 task-ledger 工作区的任务看板，并附带可全局使用的 task-ledger 技能。

description.en: ★ 728 │ Create, edit and review spreadsheets, documents and slides in DSH, with Office import and export.
description.zh: ★ 728 │ 在 DSH 内创建、编辑和审阅表格、文档与演示稿，支持 Office 导入导出。

description.en: ★ 36 │ Query A-share prices, financials, announcements and news, then organize analysis and charts.
description.zh: ★ 36 │ 查询 A 股行情、财务数据、公告和新闻，并整理分析与图表。

description.en: ★ 41 │ Automatically connects models included in the WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: ★ 41 │ 自动接入本机 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型。

description.en: ★ 109 │ Turn explicit DSH session experience into reviewable native Skills.
description.zh: ★ 109 │ 将明确的 DSH 会话经验转化为可审查的原生技能。

description.en: ★ 1,578 │ Six Agent Skills for code review, architecture audits, technical debt, test quality, project health and fixes, provided to the DSH skill registry.
description.zh: ★ 1,578 │ 向 DSH 技能注册表提供六项 Agent Skills，覆盖代码审查、架构审计、技术债、测试质量、项目健康与修复。

description.en: ★ 61 │ Configure reasoning effort for third-party models and default subagent settings.
description.zh: ★ 61 │ 为第三方模型配置思考强度，并设置子 Agent 的默认档位。

description.en: ★ 426 │ Compare 2–4 answers, files or web previews in DSH, then review and adopt a choice. Requires Git, a host process sandbox and configured models; web previews need Chrome/Edge. Static previews lack Host validation: use trusted pages and non-sensitive projects.
description.zh: ★ 426 │ 比较 2–4 版回答、文件或网页预览，再审阅并采用结果。需 Git、宿主进程沙箱和模型配置，网页预览需 Chrome/Edge。静态预览缺少 Host 校验，请仅用于可信页面和非敏感项目。

description.en: ★ 47 │ DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh: ★ 47 │ 将 ponytail 的工作方式和七级处理流程接入 DSH，提供六个可独立开关的技能及双语说明。

description.en: ★ 43 │ Inspect related subagent sessions and delete selected conversation families from the sidebar.
description.zh: ★ 43 │ 查看关联子 Agent 会话，并在侧栏选择删除会话组。

description.en: ★ 222 │ Create and inspect SillyTavern character cards and worldbooks with 23 bundled skills, an optional agent preset and a browser panel. Licensed for noncommercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.
description.zh: ★ 222 │ 通过 23 个内置技能、可选 Agent 预设与浏览器面板制作和检查 SillyTavern 角色卡、世界书；采用 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0，仅限非商业用途。

description.en: ★ 28 │ Provide a mobile interface and pairing gateway, with installable PWA and push notifications through your proxy or tunnel.
description.zh: ★ 28 │ 通过手机或其他电脑远程访问 DSH，支持配对、PWA 和推送通知，需自行配置代理或隧道。

description.en: ★ 698 │ Store conversation knowledge in Markdown cognitive graphs with recall and reflection tools.
description.zh: ★ 698 │ 将会话知识保存到 Markdown 认知图，提供召回与反思工具。

description.en: ★ 761 │ Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP stdio server + PowerShell UIA backend, bridged into DSH via @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. Read/act on real Windows desktop apps (UI Automation tree, screenshots, typed input, OCR, window management).
description.zh: ★ 761 │ 通过 UI Automation、截图、OCR 与 PowerShell 操作 Windows 应用。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Weixin (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness: command a DSH agent from WeChat, with support for images, files, and voice-note transcription.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 通过微信 iLink Bot 与 DSH 对话，支持图片、文件和语音转写。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Assign wallpapers and appearance settings to model rules and rotate matching images.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 按模型规则配置壁纸和外观，并轮播匹配的图片。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Control Windows with screenshots, UI Automation targets and verified numbered marks, then verify the result; known steps can be batched in one tool call. Each screenshot keeps a local file, and a batch creates at most one image attachment. Standard mode asks approval for each action; in a danger-full-access session that cannot show an approval card, high-risk actions run under that grant and are logged to policy.jsonl, while other sandboxes and delegated subagent sessions refuse. Windows x64 and Node >=22; native helpers are bundled.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 通过截图、UI Automation 控件和可校验的编号标记操控 Windows 并回读验证，可在一次工具调用中批量执行已知步骤。每张截图保留本地文件，每批最多生成一个图片附件。默认 standard 模式逐次审批；完全权限会话无法弹审批卡时，高危动作按该授权执行并记入 policy.jsonl，其它沙箱与被委派子会话一律拒绝。仅支持 Windows x64，需 Node >=22，随包提供原生组件。

description.en: ★ 672 │ Let DSH watch a live screen, camera or video file: frames are scored by how much the picture changed, and only the ones that matter are packed into a single image. Captures your screen while running; speech recognition uses a service you configure. Settings routes check host authentication.
description.zh: ★ 672 │ 让 DSH 实时看屏幕、摄像头或视频文件：按画面变化量给帧打分，只把有变化的几帧拼进一张图。运行时会截取你的屏幕；语音识别使用你自己配置的服务。设置接口会检查宿主认证。

description.en: ★ 24 │ Parse documents with MinerU cloud or self-hosted providers, using background jobs, cached results and shared requests.
description.zh: ★ 24 │ 通过 MinerU 云端或自托管服务解析文档，支持后台任务、产物缓存和请求合并。

description.en: ★ 31 │ Dictate into the composer, then polish the text through a dsh model before sending
description.zh: ★ 31 │ 通过语音在输入框录入文字，发送前可用模型润色；支持本地 Whisper 及云端识别服务。

description.en: ★ 23 │ Create, edit, inspect and export presentations, reverse existing decks and use bundled design systems and templates.
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 创建、编辑、检查和导出 PPT，也可解析已有演示文稿，复用其结构与设计模板。

description.en: ★ 1,470 │ Use structured learning skills and a lesson engine inside DSH.
description.zh: ★ 1,470 │ 在 DSH 中使用结构化学习技能与课程引擎。

description.en: ★ 396 │ Cross-session project memory for DeepSeek Harness: seven-layer SQLite memory, first-turn snapshot injection, per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/project tools, automatic reflection with reflection-fold UI, and idle-triggered dream consolidation (peak-hour suppressed).
description.zh: ★ 396 │ 通过 SQLite 分层记忆、检索工具与自动反思保存项目知识。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Tag sessions Finder-style from a hover button or context menu, color titles or show tag marks, and filter the list by tag. Labels are stored locally; routes use DSH host authentication. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 以 Finder 风格给会话打标签：悬浮按钮或右键标记，标题着色或显示标签符号，并按标签筛选。标签保存在本机，接口使用 DSH 宿主认证。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 26 │ TinyFish-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Seamlessly routes model web searches to the fast and privacy-friendly TinyFish Search API.
description.zh: ★ 26 │ 为 DSH 内置网页搜索接入 TinyFish Search API。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Protect the web interface with passwords or shared tokens, session cookies and login rate limits.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 为网页端添加密码或共享令牌登录、会话 Cookie、登录限速和用户管理命令。

title.zh: Better Reasoning Effort（思考强度与输入模态）

description.en: ★ 68 │ Set reasoning effort and image-input support for third-party models right in the official Models page, with suggested settings from a built-in model knowledge base.
description.zh: ★ 68 │ 在官方「模型」页直接为第三方模型设置思考强度和图片输入支持，可根据内置模型知识库一键填入推荐配置。

description.en: ★ 695 │ Edit a sidebar canvas and read or update .drawio files through diagram tools.
description.zh: ★ 695 │ 在侧栏编辑画布，并通过语义绘图工具读写 .drawio 文件。

description.en: ★ 27 │ MCP manager settings page for DeepSeek Harness: list, enable, configure and add MCP servers from the browser, written durably to the profile's user patch layer.
description.zh: ★ 27 │ 在网页设置中添加、配置和开关 MCP 服务器，配置保存到当前 Profile。

description.en: ★ 7 │ DeepSeek Harness helpers that add 11 UI languages, a Changes panel, input history, Shift+Tab /plan, one-click Continue, and chat resumption after restart. They also add queue drag-and-drop and deeplinks.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 提供多语言界面、变更面板、输入历史、计划模式和一键继续，支持重启后恢复会话及队列排序。

description.en: ★ 45 │ High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session logs, reusable DSH Web GUI
description.zh: ★ 45 │ 通过扫码登录、卡片命令与媒体消息连接飞书和 DSH。

description.en: ★ 18 │ Deterministic context-pruning compaction backend for dsh: zero-LLM summaries, /dcp command, works out of the box. Design references Opencode-DCP.
description.zh: ★ 18 │ 按规则裁剪和压缩上下文，无需模型生成摘要，可通过 /dcp 调用。

description.en: ★ 269 │ Add native search and fetch tools, optional web routing and parallel research with a settings panel. Requires Node.js 18+, Python 3.9+ and PyYAML. Set the web search/fetch provider explicitly to route built-in web tools through Argo; no DSH version range is declared. Starts an external Argo CLI through npx by default.
description.zh: ★ 269 │ 提供原生搜索与抓取工具、可选的网页工具路由、并行研究及设置面板。需要 Node.js 18+、Python 3.9+ 和 PyYAML；内置网页工具改走 Argo 时需显式配置搜索与抓取路由，包内未声明适用的 DSH 版本。 默认通过 npx 启动外部 Argo CLI。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Read official DSH documentation in the plugin page and search docs or npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在插件页阅读 DSH 官方文档，并用原生工具检索文档和 npm 元数据。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Run one project across your own Windows and macOS machines from a single DeepSeek account, with replicate, split, broadcast and pipeline modes.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 用同一个 DeepSeek 账号在你自己的 Windows 和 macOS 机器上运行同一个项目，支持复制、拆分、广播和流水线四种协同方式。

description.en: ★ 618 │ Use ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, GitHub Copilot and Google Antigravity accounts as DSH model providers, with login, multiple accounts and usage controls. Tokens are stored locally; available models and quotas depend on the account.
description.zh: ★ 618 │ 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok、GitHub Copilot 和 Google Antigravity 账号接入 DSH，支持登录、多账号及用量管理。令牌保存在本机，可用模型和额度取决于账号。

description.en: ★ 26 │ pstack coding workflows, skills, model-role settings and host subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=24.21.1; scripts use host shell tools and their declared interpreters. Browser, terminal and forge steps need optional bundles; model calls follow configured routes and pricing.
description.zh: ★ 26 │ 将 pstack 编程工作流、技能、模型角色设置和宿主子代理协作移植到 DeepSeek Harness。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=24.21.1；脚本通过宿主 shell 工具和各自解释器运行，浏览器、终端及 forge 步骤需可选组合包，模型调用按配置路由计费。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Review tool calls using global and project rules, with categorized approvals, inline diffs and sandbox escalation handling.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 结合全局与项目规则复核工具调用，显示改动差异，并处理需要在沙箱外执行的请求。

description.en: ★ 24 │ Password login gateway for dsh web: auto-generated initial password with forced onboarding, login, password change with real request interception, and OTP two-factor auth.
description.zh: ★ 24 │ 为网页端添加密码登录、初次设置、密码修改和 OTP 双因素认证。

description.en: ★ 21 │ A GitHub workflow engine for DeepSeek Harness with native GitHub CLI (gh) integration. It provides 18 agent tools for PRs, CI diagnosis, releases, secrets, rulesets, and Copilot dispatch, plus /gh shortcuts.
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 通过 gh 在 DSH 中管理 PR、排查 CI、发布版本，并操作密钥、规则集和 Copilot 任务。

description.en: ★ 12 │ Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg backgrounds with embedded video, scheduled switching, blur and a local rotation library.
description.zh: ★ 12 │ 加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 背景，支持内嵌视频、时段切换、虚化和本地轮换库。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Turn TiddlyWiki 5 into a local, plain-text knowledge base under Git that you and the agent read and write together. It is not an automatic memory plugin; publishing to WeChat Official Account drafts is optional.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成你和 Agent 共用的本地知识库，纯文本并用 Git 管理。不在后台自动记忆，可选发布到微信公众号草稿箱。

description.en: ★ 64 │ Preset editing, prompt injection, and DeepSeek adapter configuration.
description.zh: ★ 64 │ 预设编辑、提示词注入与 DeepSeek 适配器配置。

description.en: ★ 150 │ Turn-level conversation and workspace rewind for DeepSeek Harness, powered by a persistent Change Ledger
description.zh: ★ 150 │ 基于持久变更账本回退会话轮次和工作区文件。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Forward DingTalk private messages and group mentions to a personal WeChat bot, with configurable batching. Requires account authorization and the DWS CLI; optional global installation of DWS 1.0.66 uses the configured registry after confirmation.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 将钉钉私信与群聊 @ 消息合并推送到个人微信机器人，可调合并间隔。需授权账号并配置 DWS CLI；可在确认后从配置的源全局安装固定的 DWS 1.0.66。

description.en: ★ 263 │ Preview, inspect, and edit real .op OpenPencil design documents inside DSH conversations — headless rendering, a read-only canvas, and a managed editor.
description.zh: ★ 263 │ 在会话中预览、检查与编辑 OpenPencil 设计文档。

description.en: ★ 789 │ Turn the current session into an editable thought graph on an infinite canvas.
description.zh: ★ 789 │ 将当前会话整理为无限画布上的可编辑思维图。

description.en: ★ 193 │ Use a visible browser that the agent can automate and the user can take over.
description.zh: ★ 193 │ 使用可由 Agent 自动操作、也可由用户接管的可见浏览器。

description.en: ★ 10,458 │ Browse, enable, create and remove skills grouped by their source.
description.zh: ★ 10,458 │ 按来源浏览、开关、创建和删除技能。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Add timeline navigation, folders, prompts, export, Mermaid, quoted replies, appearance controls and usage displays.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 提供时间线、文件夹、提示词、导出、Mermaid、引用回复、外观设置和用量显示。

description.en: ★ 5 │ WeChat (iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 通过微信 iLink/ClawBot 接入 DSH 消息通道。

description.en: ★ 12 │ Deploy DSH to a VPS over SSH and manage its HTTPS gateway, service state and upgrades.
description.zh: ★ 12 │ 通过 SSH 把 DSH 部署到 VPS，并管理 HTTPS 网关、服务状态和升级。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Configure and reorder desktop status fields, with token costs, custom model prices, currencies and account balance.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 配置和排序桌面状态字段，显示 Token 费用、自定义模型单价、币种和账户余额。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Quote selected text from chat, file previews or terminals, add comments and open side conversations or source locations.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 引用对话、文件预览或终端中的选中文字，添加评论，打开侧边对话或跳回原文。

description.en: ★ 7 │ OpenRouter Provider List sets provider and quantization limits for OpenRouter requests, injected as provider.only, provider.order, and provider.quantizations. It can optionally route through billion-context.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 设置 OpenRouter 请求使用的上游供应商、调用顺序和量化规格，可经 billion-context 转发。

title.zh: Codex Effort Slider（推理强度滑条）

description.en: ★ 276 │ Replace the reasoning-effort levels in the composer with a continuous Codex-style slider, colored by level.
description.zh: ★ 276 │ 把输入框里的推理档位换成 Codex 风格的连续滑条，每一档配色不同。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Exposes this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen CIDR range, such as Tailscale, on DSH 0.2.1+. It can require an optional numeric access code and provides a phone layout that applies only to remote pages.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 将网页界面开放给指定网段，可设置数字访问码，并为远程页面提供手机布局。

description.en: ★ 3 │ A suite of 18 independently switchable tools for side chats, annotations, code review and Git worktrees. Requires Git, Node ^22.19 or >=24 and DSH >=0.2.2-rc.2; optional pull requests use gh. Worktree setup scripts run when selected; reviews and delegated work may consume model credit.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 包含侧聊、批注、代码审查与 Git 工作树等 18 项可独立启停的增强功能。需 Git、Node ^22.19 或 >=24 和 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.2，可选 PR 功能使用 gh；选用工作树初始化时会运行相应脚本，审查与委派可能消耗模型额度。

description.en: ★ 3 │ The state service of DSH Agentic Roleplay: one SQLite database per session, used by other plugins. Most users should install the complete @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all instead.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ DSH Agentic Roleplay 的状态服务，每个会话一个 SQLite 数据库，供其他插件调用。一般用户建议安装完整的 @dsh-agentic-roleplay/all。

description.en: ★ 5 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: lets text-only models receive pasted images and analyze them with a built-in OpenAI-compatible vision tool.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 让纯文本模型接收粘贴的图片，再调用兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉工具分析。

description.en: ★ 278 │ dsh-skill-mcp-panel: manage skills and MCP servers from the DSH web sidebar plus the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh: ★ 278 │ 通过网页侧栏与命令行统一管理技能和 MCP 服务器。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Schedule reminders or delayed messages from commands and a panel, with delivery handled by the host.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 通过命令或面板安排提醒和延迟消息，由宿主负责到时投递。

description.en: ★ 698 │ Connect AnySearch web search, page fetching and advanced search tools to DSH.
description.zh: ★ 698 │ 为 DSH 接入 AnySearch 网页搜索、正文抓取与高级检索工具。

description.en: ★ 195 │ Generate and edit images through configurable provider channels in the web interface.
description.zh: ★ 195 │ 在网页界面配置供应商通道，生成或编辑图片。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Switch a session between Standard and Fast and adjust reasoning effort per model. Fast sets the priority service tier on matching Responses requests and forwards them, with their auth header, to the target endpoint the admin configures, so that target must be trusted; incomplete config rejects Fast requests. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 and Node >=22.19.0.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在会话中切换 Standard / Fast 档位并按模型调整推理强度。Fast 为匹配的 Responses 请求设置 priority 服务档位，并连同授权头转发到管理员配置的目标端点，目标须可信；配置不完整时拒绝 Fast 请求。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5、Node >=22.19.0。

description.en: ★ 132 │ Looping video background and a skippable startup clip, with local media upload and opacity controls. Startup audio is enabled by default; dark-theme switching asks by default. Media and appearance routes lack Host authentication; use only on a trusted local host.
description.zh: ★ 132 │ 循环视频背景与可跳过的开机短片，支持本地上传和透明度调节。开机声音默认开启，切换深色主题默认先询问。 媒体和外观接口尚无宿主认证，仅用于受信本机。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Display the current model provider’s balance, subscription quotas, and reset times above the composer.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 在输入框上方显示当前模型供应商的账户余额、套餐额度及重置时间。

description.en: ★ 3 │ DSH inline follow-up questions answered in a side card: select text in chat or task areas to ask in place, with a separate subagent streaming the answer, optionally sent back to the main conversation.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 选中文字后在侧边卡片中追问，由独立子 Agent 流式回答，结果可发回主对话。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Delete sessions and their owned subagents from the interface or a tool, stopping running sessions and clearing stored artifacts.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 从界面或工具删除会话及其拥有的子 Agent，会先停止运行会话并清理存储产物。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Apply six Everforest light and dark palettes with three contrast levels and per-browser persistence.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 提供六套 Everforest 明暗配色与三档对比度，并按浏览器保存选择。

description.en: ★ 59 │ Customize theme colors and image or video wallpapers with separate opacity and blur controls for interface areas.
description.zh: ★ 59 │ 自定义主题色与图片或视频壁纸，分别调整各区域的透明度和模糊度。

description.en: ★ 34 │ Manage MCP servers and skills in one panel: add, edit and remove MCP entries, import settings from other agents, and embed the plugin market when dshmarket is installed. Works in Web and Desktop.
description.zh: ★ 34 │ 在一个面板里管理 MCP 服务和技能：增删改 MCP 条目、导入其他 Agent 的配置；安装 dshmarket 时内嵌插件市场。Web 和桌面端通用。

description.en: ★ 62 │ Show the current model, account balance or subscription quota, and session or historical spending beneath the composer.
description.zh: ★ 62 │ 在输入框下方显示模型、余额或订阅额度，以及会话与历史费用。

description.en: ★ 10 │ A bundle of session plugins that adds in-place edit, retry, recall and fork to conversations in DSH Web.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 组合多个会话插件，为 DSH Web 的对话提供就地编辑、重试、撤回和分支。

description.en: ★ 11 │ Displays local images, audio, video, PDF, Office files and HTML in chat. Office preview uses the Host converter or separately installed LibreOffice; HTML scripts run in a sandbox. Requires a supported DSH version and Node.js ^22.19 or 24+.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 在对话内预览本地图片、音视频、PDF、Office 文件与 HTML。Office 预览使用宿主转换器或另装 LibreOffice；HTML 脚本在沙箱中运行。需匹配声明范围的 DSH 与 Node.js ^22.19 或 24+。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Inspect WorkBuddy, WorkBuddy AI and ZCode CLI provider setup with observed, inferred and unavailable evidence. Basic checks are offline; optional connection checks can start provider diagnostic processes. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 只读检查 WorkBuddy、WorkBuddy AI、ZCode CLI 的连接配置，区分观测、推断与未知。基础检查离线，可选连接检查会启动提供商诊断进程；需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Show the current conversation as a step map with progress sources, tools and file types. Queue a prompt for the next step of a running agent and revoke it before consumption.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 将当前会话显示为分步地图，标注进度来源、工具和文件类型；可向运行中的 Agent 下一步追加提示，并在取用前撤回。

description.en: ★ 669 │ Show a live status line while the agent works: current phase, the tool actually running, elapsed time and a summary when the turn ends. Works in the TUI, Web UI and desktop app.
description.zh: ★ 669 │ Agent 工作时显示一行实时状态：当前阶段、正在运行的工具、已用时间和回合结束摘要，终端、网页和桌面端通用。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Restart the Windows desktop app through a detached helper, with confirmation, delay and executable path settings.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 通过独立助手重启 Windows 桌面端，可设置确认、延时和目标程序路径。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Replace stock shell and file tools with persistent Bash, structured reads, multiple edit modes and atomic writes.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 用持久 Bash、结构化文件读取、多种编辑方式、原子写入和安全删除替换基础工具。

description.en: ★ 4 │ DIY your DSH UI fonts: per-region font, size, weight, and color for Chinese and English, pick-to-create regions, unified overrides, saved themes, random color schemes, and one-click install of cute fonts.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 按区域调整中英文字体、字号、字重和颜色，保存主题，并支持随机配色和字体安装。

description.en: ★ 124 │ Move, archive and tag sessions in batches, and manage workspace visibility and preset migration.
description.zh: ★ 124 │ 批量移动、归档和标记会话，管理工作区显示与预设迁移。

description.en: ★ 6 │ OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 在 OpenViking Studio 面板管理记忆，在会话中查看记忆保存记录和检索内容。

description.en: ★ 116 │ Import, switch and manage bundled or custom conversation personas.
description.zh: ★ 116 │ 导入、切换和管理内置或自定义会话人设。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Arrange session statistics, tasks, context, heatmaps, references and quota widgets in a configurable sidebar grid.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 在侧栏网格中自由排列会话统计、任务、上下文、热力图、引用和额度等组件。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show the selected provider balance and estimated spend in the composer. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0 and configured credentials. Balance discovery probes the configured provider; observed balance changes are estimates rather than a bill.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在输入框显示当前供应商余额与估算消耗。需 DSH ≥0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0 并配置凭据；自动发现会探测已配置供应商的余额接口，余额变化仅作估算，以实际账单为准。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Point at an element on a proxied page, adjust it live and send structured visual feedback to the agent. Pages are loaded through a local proxy; drawings are kept in the overlay and the host store, not exposed to the page. Requires Node >=20; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在本地代理打开的网页上指向元素、实时调整，并把结构化视觉反馈发给 Agent。页面经本地代理加载；绘图保存在浮层和宿主存储中，不再暴露给页面。需 Node >=20，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Organize workspaces and sessions in virtual folders with tags and tree search. First content search creates a local index that may contain all persisted session text and remains after uninstall. Requires Node >=24.9.0 and DSH 0.2.2-rc.2.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 用虚拟文件夹、标签和树形搜索整理工作区与会话。首次正文搜索会建立本机索引，可能包含全部持久化会话正文，卸载后仍保留。需 Node >=24.9.0、DSH 0.2.2-rc.2。

description.en: ★ 183 │ Sign in with a ChatGPT account to use Codex models in DSH. Declares support up to DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: ★ 183 │ 用 ChatGPT 账号登录，在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型。声明支持到 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: ★ 132 │ Claude Code style auto-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: typed memory files + MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt
description.zh: ★ 132 │ 自动注入 MEMORY.md 索引，管理分类的跨会话记忆文件。

description.en: ★ 104 │ Usage billing dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar cost metrics plus a full dashboard modal, priced from a current multi-provider catalog with real usage aggregated from session logs.
description.zh: ★ 104 │ 从会话日志汇总实际用量，显示多供应商价格与侧栏费用指标。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Build local web apps from templates with file imports, live previews and Git checkpoints. Creates project files, installs dependencies and starts development servers under host permissions or approval. Requires Node >=20, Git and DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0; model and optional speech calls may incur charges.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过模板创建本地 Web 应用，支持文件导入、实时预览和 Git 检查点；会按宿主权限或审批写入文件、安装依赖并启动开发服务。需 Node >=20、Git 与 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0，模型及可选语音调用可能产生费用。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Rewrite supported shell commands and compress large tool results through rtk. Recovery hints explain omitted output; savings appear below the composer and in /rtk stats. Falls back when rtk cannot rewrite. Platform binaries use optional npm packages; Node >=22.19 is required.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 通过 rtk 改写受支持的 shell 命令、压缩较大的工具结果，并提示省略内容和原文恢复方式。省量显示在输入框下方及 /rtk stats；无法改写时回退。平台二进制通过可选 npm 包安装，需 Node >=22.19。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Injects a small continuity pointer when a new session starts; if there is no handoff document, it prefers reusing the previous session's compaction summary.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在新会话中注入简短的交接提示，没有交接文档时优先使用上一会话的压缩摘要。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Inspect model catalogs, provider status, balances and usage, and connect locally installed coding agents.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 查看模型目录、供应商状态、余额配额与用量，并接入本机编程助手。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Keep notes, tags and attachments in Host storage, preview Markdown and tasks, send notes with real attachments to chat, import or export JSON and let Agents read and edit notes. The author requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 在 Host 端保存便签、标签和附件，预览 Markdown 与待办，把便签及真实附件发送到对话，支持 JSON 导入导出和 Agent 读写。作者要求 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或更高版本。

description.en: ★ 95 │ Fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling for DeepSeek Harness replies, including Markdown, code blocks, tables, and tool results.
description.zh: ★ 95 │ 调整 Markdown、代码、表格与工具结果的流式渲染和滚动。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Notify when DSH Web sessions finish, fail, need approval or ask a question. Browser notifications focus an existing session tab; Windows/WSL toasts open a new tab. Requires notification permission and PowerShell for Windows toasts.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ DSH Web 会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送通知。浏览器通知优先聚焦已有会话标签页，Windows/WSL Toast 新开标签页；需允许通知，Windows Toast 另需 PowerShell。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Git branch and worktree management: shows and switches the current branch in the input toolbar, with an IDEA-style branch picker, remote checkout, right-click actions, push/update, and isolated worktree workspaces.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在输入框切换和管理 Git 分支，支持远程分支、推送、更新，以及独立 Git 工作树。

description.en: ★ 3,119 │ Switch installed skins and edit each skin's options from Settings.
description.zh: ★ 3,119 │ 在设置页切换已安装的皮肤，并调整各皮肤自带的选项。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Manage MCP servers, skills and tools per session and inspect their context loading state.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 按会话管理 MCP 服务器、技能和工具，查看它们在上下文中的加载状态。

description.en: ★ 3 │ View desktop usage, provider quotas and custom queries, with optional WorkBuddy credits and an extended model selector.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 查看桌面用量、供应商配额与自定义查询，可选 WorkBuddy 积分和扩展模型选择器。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Use Agnes in DSH with at-a-glance quota, models, and image and video tools; image recognition and thinking levels are auto-filled, and AgnesCode credentials are reused automatically.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 接入 Agnes 模型和图片、视频工具，查看额度，并复用 AgnesCode 登录凭据。

description.en: ★ 133 │ Connect local ACP agents to DSH. Requires an ACP-capable CLI; agents retain their own permissions and service costs. Optional automatic approvals and missing-CLI installation require explicit configuration.
description.zh: ★ 133 │ 在 DSH 中接入本机 ACP Agent。需支持 ACP 的命令行工具，权限与服务费用由所接入的 Agent 决定。 可选自动授权与缺命令时自动安装需自行配置。

description.en: ★ 162 │ Manage preset and custom prompt templates and insert them into the composer.
description.zh: ★ 162 │ 管理预设和自定义模板，一键插入当前输入框。

description.en: ★ 168 │ Superpowers for the DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers
description.zh: ★ 168 │ 为 DSH 接入测试驱动开发、调试、规划与协作技能。

description.en: ★ 3 │ A skill-only bundle that makes a five-part Feynman-style answer the default shape for explanatory replies: conclusion, numbered points, summary, takeaway and action, then a one-sentence Occam cut. MIT; ships a skill and a Cordis patch, no host JavaScript entry.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 纯技能包：把费曼五段式（先结论、编号论点、总结、启示与行动，最后压成一句话）作为解释型回答的默认骨架。MIT 许可，仅含技能与 Cordis 补丁，没有宿主 JavaScript 入口。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Let agents offer voice calls; accept, reject or defer them, with local speech synthesis after acceptance.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 让 Agent 发起语音来电，可接听、拒绝或稍后处理，接听后通过本地语音合成播放。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Provider-first model picker with sorting, aliases and favorites; preferences stay in this browser.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 供应商优先的模型选择面板，支持排序、别名和收藏，偏好保存在当前浏览器。

description.en: ★ 9 │ OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 接入 OpenCode Zen/Go，保持会话与网关的对应关系，提供免费档工具调用回退和 Go 额度显示。

description.en: ★ 46 │ Manage local skills from multiple coding agents, import them into DSH and browse a skill market.
description.zh: ★ 46 │ 管理多个编程助手的本地技能，导入 DSH，并浏览技能市场。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Turn conversation Markdown headings into a searchable outline with previews and navigation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 把会话中的 Markdown 标题整理为可搜索大纲，支持预览与跳转。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Copy complete conversations to another workspace and archive their originals, with bulk organization, folder registration and renaming. Also offers confirmed permanent deletion of closed sessions. Log deletion assumes the standard JSONL backend. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 复制完整会话到其他工作区并归档原记录，支持批量整理、注册目录和改名，也提供确认后永久删除已关闭会话的功能。日志删除依赖默认 JSONL 存储布局。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: ★ 73 │ Provide switchable Russian localization for DSH and ecosystem plugins.
description.zh: ★ 73 │ 为 DSH 核心与生态插件提供可切换的俄语界面。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Connect Kimi Code subscription models using API keys or device sign-in, with web search and quota displays.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 接入 Kimi Code 订阅模型，支持设备登录、网页搜索和额度查询。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Record model token usage and estimated costs, then query historical statistics from Settings.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 记录模型 Token 用量和费用估算，在设置页查询历史统计。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Show clickable follow-up suggestions below replies and send a selected suggestion as a user message.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 在回复下方显示可点击的后续建议，选中后作为用户消息发送。

description.en: ★ 127 │ Tabbit Browser bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a code-first tabbit_browser tool, browser-backed web_fetch, @tab composer mentions, a dedicated page-access permission, an environment preflight with background installer download, and a daily plugin update check.
description.zh: ★ 127 │ 操作 Tabbit 标签页，抓取网页，并在输入框引用浏览器内容。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Analyze video shots, transcripts and visual evidence, run segment-by-segment analysis jobs, and export reports. Requires local media tools; Whisper/OCR enhancements need additional Python packages. Model analysis uses your configured DSH model.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 分析视频镜头、台词与画面证据，按分段任务深度拉片并导出报告。需要本地媒体工具，Whisper/OCR 增强需另配 Python 环境；模型分析使用 DSH 中配置的模型。

description.en: ★ 33 │ Layered memory that captures conversations, extracts facts, consolidates scenes and distills a profile, then recalls what is relevant before each model step. The pipeline is adapted from TencentDB Agent Memory.
description.zh: ★ 33 │ 分层蒸馏记忆：自动记录对话、抽取原子记忆、整合场景并提炼画像，在每次模型调用前召回相关内容。管线设计移植自 TencentDB Agent Memory。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Configure Gemini API and Vertex AI decoding, protocols and service tiers, and inspect responses, usage and estimated costs.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 配置 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 的解码、协议和服务等级，并检查响应、用量与费用估算。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Daily journal and calendar for DeepSeek Harness: the journal_record tool appends one JSON file per day, and the right sidebar draws it as a calendar.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 记录每日日记，按天保存在 JSON 文件中，并在右侧栏日历中查看。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Manage projects, labels, priorities and recurring tasks, with natural-language capture, statistics, import/export and agent tools.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 管理项目、标签、优先级和重复任务，支持自然语言添加、统计、导入导出及 Agent 工具。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Arranges the left sidebar's workspaces and sessions as tabs or an overlay, or leaves the official layout untouched, and manages temporary sessions that are deleted on quit by default (daily cleanup off by default; right-click to keep or delete). Routes are registered through connection.fetch.register(). No engines.dsh range declared; tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.2. MIT.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 把左侧栏的「工作区」和「会话」排成标签页或浮层，也可选官方默认不干预；另管理临时会话，默认退出 DSH 时删除（每日定时清理默认关，右键可保留或立即删除）。接口通过 connection.fetch.register() 注册。未声明 engines.dsh，已在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 上验证。MIT 许可。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Pause DeepSeek work during peak-price windows and resume or schedule it for off-peak hours. Model tools are limited to their current session; settings require host authentication. Requires Node >=22.5; automatic resume can start model work and incur charges.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DeepSeek 峰价时段暂停任务，谷价时恢复或执行规划。模型工具限当前会话，设置接口要求宿主认证。需 Node >=22.5；自动恢复可能启动模型任务并产生费用。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Development dashboard: embeds the control-your-development product dashboard into the DSH right sidebar and session page.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 将 control-your-development 的项目开发面板嵌入 DSH 侧栏和会话页。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Provide a Tavily backend for web search, with credential storage, key rotation and failover.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 为网页搜索接入 Tavily，支持凭据存储、密钥轮换和失败切换。

description.en: ★ 170 │ A DSH Web theme in the style of the Arknights: Endfield website: cream paper, ink text, signal-yellow accents and square corners, with optional animated backgrounds.
description.zh: ★ 170 │ 参考《明日方舟：终末地》官网风格的 DSH Web 主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄强调色和直角，可选动态背景。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Edit web plugin sources, preview changes and run patch checks and builds from a workbench.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 在工作台编辑网页插件源码、预览改动，并运行补丁检查和构建。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Provide a terminal coding interface and a staged /ship workflow for specifications, tests and acceptance.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 提供终端编码界面和 /ship 工作流，分阶段完成需求说明、测试与验收。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Shows the current workspace's Git commit graph in the right sidebar of DSH Desktop. Desktop profile only; needs git on PATH.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH 桌面端右侧栏显示当前工作区的 Git 提交图。仅支持桌面端，需要本机已安装 git。

description.en: ★ 105 │ Task priorities, full checklists and a draggable floating task panel. Coexists as todo_write_plus; requires Node.js 24+ and the declared DSH 0.2 prerelease range.
description.zh: ★ 105 │ 提供优先级、完整清单与可拖动浮动任务面板，默认以 todo_write_plus 共存；需 Node.js 24+ 和声明的 DSH 0.2 预发布兼容范围。

description.en: Switch between shareable themes with wallpapers, accent colors and translucent surfaces.
description.zh: 切换可分享的主题，调整壁纸、强调色与半透明界面。

description.en: ★ 29 │ Escape from Tarkov themed plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a hero beta-warning banner, translucent looping video background, background music dock, and event sound effects.
description.zh: ★ 29 │ 应用《逃离塔科夫》主题，提供视频背景、背景音乐和事件提示音。

description.en: ★ 2 │ DeepSeek Harness browser provider: reads a page as an indexed action space, then runs one guarded operation at a time.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 把网页内容整理成带编号的可操作目标，再逐步执行带权限检查的浏览器操作。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Organize sourced company and job research, verify registered entities and generate evidence-bounded reports and interview questions.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 整理公司与岗位的调查资料，核验登记主体，在证据支持的范围内生成报告、核对清单和面试问题。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Manage SDKs, AVDs and emulators, scaffold Kotlin/Compose projects, and build, install, inspect and operate Android apps.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 管理 SDK、AVD 和模拟器，创建 Kotlin/Compose 工程，并构建、安装、检查和操作 Android 应用。

description.en: ★ 103 │ Adds a Block PTC agent preset that groups tool work into blocks and replaces selected context with model-written summaries. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 and Node >=22; select the new preset explicitly. Summaries may lose details; original events remain in the session log.
description.zh: ★ 103 │ 新增 Block PTC 预设，按区块组织工具工作，用模型摘要替换选定上下文。需 DSH ≥0.2.1-rc.2、Node ≥22，使用时需选择新预设；摘要可能遗漏细节，原始事件仍保留在会话日志。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Route and narrow the visible tool set by task stage, track token overhead and restore tools when a task ends. Includes the former Task Guard tools. Changes tool visibility and routing prompts; it does not replace host permissions or guarantee token savings.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 按任务阶段切换和收窄工具表，记录 token 开销，任务结束后恢复；已合入原 Task Guard 的任务工具。会改变工具可见性和路由提示词，不替代宿主权限，节省效果随会话而异。

description.en: ★ 104 │ Learn traceable experience from test-verified Python repairs in one repository. Experimental alpha for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.5 Web and Node >=24.10; learning is off by default. Verification executes trusted repository code; optional model sharing sends bounded repair material to the configured provider and may incur charges.
description.zh: ★ 104 │ 从单仓库中通过测试验证的 Python 修复积累可追溯经验。实验性 alpha，支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.5 Web，需 Node >=24.10；学习默认关闭。验证会执行已授权的仓库代码，可选模型共享会发送有限修复材料并可能产生费用。

description.en: ★ 221 │ Run unmodified Pi extensions as native DSH plugins, with compatibility checks and translation of Pi MCP settings.
description.zh: ★ 221 │ 让 Pi 扩展不经修改就作为 DSH 原生插件运行，并提供兼容性检查和 Pi MCP 配置转换。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Plan multi-agent tasks in isolated worktrees and merge results through review gates.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 安排多个 Agent 在独立 Git 工作树中执行任务，经审查确认后合并结果。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Move DSH workspaces, conversations and selected project files between computers, with import previews and rollback of items created during this run. Migration bundles can contain private project data; keep a backup.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 将 DSH 工作区、对话和选定项目文件迁到另一台电脑，支持导入预览及回滚本次新建的项目。迁移包可能含私密资料，操作前请备份。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Browse commit graphs and diffs, stage or discard changes, amend commits and create repositories or pull requests through gh.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 查看 Git 提交图和差异，暂存或丢弃改动、修改上次提交，并通过 gh 创建仓库或拉取请求。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Read-only filename and document-text search using Everything/es.exe and Anytxt. Requires these local engines; searches may include files outside the workspace. Diagnostic routes do not verify host identity; use only on a trusted local machine.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过 Everything/es.exe 和 Anytxt 只读搜索本机文件名与文档正文；需另行安装并运行对应引擎，搜索范围可包含工作区外文件。 诊断路由未校验宿主身份，仅限可信本机使用。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Export session dialogue as a readable Markdown file from the session header or /md. Ordinary tool output and reasoning are omitted; exported dialogue may contain sensitive information. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过会话标题栏或 /md 将对话导出为可读的 Markdown，过滤常规工具输出和思考过程；对话正文可能含敏感信息。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Replace the composer model picker with a searchable flat grid of models, reasoning levels and teamwork controls. Works in Web and Desktop. Sends a daily installation heartbeat to dsh.zuos.us containing a random install ID and version/platform metadata.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将输入框模型选择器改为可搜索的平铺面板，集中显示模型、思考等级与协作开关，支持 Web 和桌面版。默认每日向 dsh.zuos.us 发送随机安装 ID、版本和平台等安装统计。

description.en: ★ 56 │ Transcribe and search PDFs, then read papers with a built-in viewer and conversation tools.
description.zh: ★ 56 │ 提取和检索 PDF 内容，通过内置阅读器配合会话阅读论文。

description.en: ★ 1 │ dsh workspace code review plugin: wraps open-code-review (ocr CLI) as 5 model tools, plus a settings card that applies a provider and model from the host provider list to the OCR config.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将 open-code-review 命令行接入 DSH 代码审查，并在设置中选择审查所用的供应商和模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect AgentScope Platform models, account pools, credits and check-in controls to DSH. Requires an AgentScope account, Node >=22.16 and DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1; model calls consume platform credits. Optional alerts use the local dsh-im service.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 接入 AgentScope Platform 模型、账号池、额度与签到管理。需平台账号、Node >=22.16 和 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1；模型调用消耗平台额度，可选通知使用本机 dsh-im 服务。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Append a passage from a browser-local EPUB/TXT/MD book below real reasoning or tool output when selected chat regions expand. Reading progress stays in the browser; novel text is not written to conversations. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 and Node >=22; EPUB is text-only and excludes DRM.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 展开选中的聊天区域时，在真实思考或工具输出下追加本地 EPUB/TXT/MD 小说，并保存各书进度；小说不写入会话数据。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Node >=22，依赖聊天 DOM；EPUB 只取文字，不支持 DRM。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Edit per-model reasoning levels, endpoint values, input modalities and token limits in Settings.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 在设置中逐模型调整推理强度、服务地址、输入类型和 Token 上限。

description.en: ★ 189 │ Run local or remote ComfyUI workflows with asset panels and per-workflow skills.
description.zh: ★ 189 │ 运行本机或远程 ComfyUI 工作流，管理素材面板与工作流技能。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show DSH session activity in a Windows companion overlay. Automatically copies and launches its bundled native app; other terminals need separate reporters. Requires Node >=24.9.0 and DSH >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0; DSH approvals stay in the host.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 Windows 浮窗查看 DSH 会话状态，自动复制并启动包内原生程序；其他终端需另装 reporter。需 Node >=24.9.0、DSH >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0；DSH 审批仍由宿主处理。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Run role-based subagents in parallel with per-role model and reasoning settings and a task sidebar.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 并行运行按角色配置的子 Agent，为各角色设置模型与思考深度，并提供任务侧栏。

description.en: ★ 158 │ Unified capability management for the DeepSeek Harness: catalog (ctx.capability) + meta_search/meta_invoke + Resident/On-demand/Disabled projection policy + 能力菜单 settings tab, in one installable bundle (server + browser).
description.zh: ★ 158 │ 统一管理工具等能力，支持按需查找、调用，以及常驻、按需加载和停用设置。

description.en: ★ 18 │ Free-tier model aggregation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): registers a freeroute provider over a pool of free-quota upstreams such as OpenCode Zen, B.AI, OpenRouter and SenseNova.
description.zh: ★ 18 │ 将 OpenCode Zen、B.AI、OpenRouter、SenseNova 等来源的免费额度模型汇总为一个供应商。

description.en: ★ 338 │ Connect the local Craft Anything CLI to inspect websites, apps and games and assist reconstruction. Includes an authenticated management panel and dependency installers; prepare the CLI and engines you need. Native tools, downloaded dependencies and coding-agent API usage have separate requirements.
description.zh: ★ 338 │ 接入本机 Craft Anything CLI，检查网站、应用与游戏并辅助重建，提供管理面板和依赖安装工具。需准备 CLI 及所用引擎，部分工具涉及原生程序、依赖下载或编码智能体的 API 费用。

title.zh: 战双帕弥什 · 赛琳娜桌宠

description.en: ★ 2 │ A Selena desktop companion with task reactions, voice, expressions and balance status. Requires local Windows 10/11 x64; the plugin downloads a separate roughly 345 MiB runtime after user action and verifies its hash. Code is MIT; character, voice and artwork have separate rights notices.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 赛琳娜桌宠提供任务反馈、语音表情与余额显示。需本机 Windows 10/11 x64，用户操作后另行下载约 345 MiB 程序并校验哈希。代码为 MIT，角色、语音和素材另有权利声明。

description.en: ★ 2 │ DSH Cordis plugin: announces the moment an agent finishes (turns idle) by pushing a 'done' signal from the host half into the falling-ts-web-ding settings namespace that the browser half reads.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在 Agent 完成任务并进入空闲时，向网页界面发送完成提示音信号。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Browse, edit and run notebook cells from a sidebar panel or MCP tools, with local kernels or an existing Jupyter server. Prepare Python and the notebook environment yourself; cells execute code.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过侧栏面板或 MCP 工具浏览、编辑和运行 Notebook 单元格，可使用本地内核或已有 Jupyter 服务。需自行准备 Python 与 Notebook 环境，运行单元格会执行代码。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Rewrite the composer draft through an auxiliary model, or request a command result without changing the draft.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过辅助模型改写输入框草稿，也可用命令查看结果而不修改草稿。

description.en: ★ 8 │ DSH image generation plugin backed by a local ComfyUI server, exposing one unified generate_image tool (text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, background removal).
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 通过本机 ComfyUI 生成图片，支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘和背景移除。

description.en: ★ 1 │ OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness: live gateway catalog, per-conversation session header, and usage.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Go，读取网关模型目录，显示会话信息和用量。

description.en: ★ 104 │ Mobile client for the DeepSeek Harness — use the dsh on your dev machine from your Android or iOS phone, remotely across networks, peer-to-peer over iroh with no server to set up (falls back to a relay that only sees ciphertext)
description.zh: ★ 104 │ 从 Android 或 iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 DSH，支持点对点连接和中继转发。

description.en: ★ 10 │ DSH plugin: start and stop a local llama.cpp llama-server from Settings → Plugins, with two model slots (A/B), per-slot model-file selection, and eight editable launch parameters.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 在插件设置中启动或停止本机 llama.cpp 服务，支持两个模型配置和启动参数调整。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Distribute requests across API keys of the same provider, with concurrency limits, 429 failover and balance cards. Keys are sent to their configured provider; local fallback storage is used when the host credential service is unavailable.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在同一服务商的多把 API Key 间分配请求，提供并发上限、429 换 Key 和余额卡片。Key 会发往所配置的服务商；宿主凭据服务不可用时使用本地备用存储。

description.en: ★ 175 │ Generate game sprites, animation frames, maps, images and music through dedicated tools.
description.zh: ★ 175 │ 通过专用工具生成游戏精灵、动画帧、地图、图片与音乐。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Convert between 27 video, audio and image formats, trim, strip audio or video without re-encoding, export embedded subtitles, compress images and edit metadata, all through your local ffmpeg. The same engine is available to the agent as a tool. All routes require DSH host authentication.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用本机 ffmpeg 在 27 种视频、音频、图片格式间互转，支持裁剪、不重编码剥离音轨或画面、导出内嵌字幕、图片压缩和元数据改写；同一引擎也提供给 agent 作为工具。所有接口都需要 DSH 宿主认证。

description.en: ★ 103 │ Cherry Studio-style knowledge base system for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): bases, documents, chunking, embeddings (OpenAI-compatible / Ollama / local / lexical fallback), retrieval, model-facing tools, and a browser management panel
description.zh: ★ 103 │ 管理文档、分块与向量检索，并通过工具和面板查询知识库。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Fish's all-in-one DSH plugin bundle, inserting plugin rows for 13 plugins in one click. Eleven are subpackages in this repo, such as approval-guide and git-graph-fish, and two are external add-ons.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 一键添加 Fish 插件合集中的 13 个插件，其中包含本仓库组件和外部配套插件。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Rearrange columns, panels and settings with saved layouts and a visual layout board. Uses host UI structure; older loaders fall back to the editor panel.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 调整三栏、面板与设置页，保存布局方案并通过白板编排。依赖宿主界面结构，旧版加载器会回退到编辑面板。

description.en: ★ 84 │ Track project tasks and run them in sessions with optional per-task Git worktrees.
description.zh: ★ 84 │ 跟踪项目任务并在会话中执行，可为任务配置独立 Git 工作树。

description.en: ★ 54 │ Branch recursively from an answer into read-only follow-ups, with a conversation tree. Requires an Agent-scoped tool guard; model calls use the configured provider.
description.zh: ★ 54 │ 从回答递归分出只读追问并查看会话树；要求宿主支持 Agent 级工具守卫，模型请求仍使用已配置供应商。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Replace the compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff and keep compressed messages readable through a segmented directory.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 用五部分交接文档生成压缩摘要，并提供分段目录，方便查看被压缩的消息。

description.en: ★ 63 │ DSH web plugin: VSCode Remote-SSH-like remote development (SSH to supercomputers/servers, remote workspace, file explorer, integrated terminal), integrated with dsh-better-sidebar and DSH settings.
description.zh: ★ 63 │ 通过 SSH 在服务器或超算上开发，在远程工作区使用文件浏览器和终端。

description.en: ★ 168 │ Previewable cross-preset session migration for DeepSeek Harness with bounded, fixed-schema handoffs
description.zh: ★ 168 │ 预览并生成结构化交接资料，在不同预设之间迁移会话。

description.en: ★ 72 │ Connect DSH to the DSH Browser Control extension through a local WebSocket bridge, with browser tools and a settings switch. Requires the browser extension; renamed from @caob23/dsh-browser-control.
description.zh: ★ 72 │ 通过本地 WebSocket 桥连接 DSH Browser Control 浏览器扩展，提供网页操作工具与设置开关。需要配套扩展，原包名为 @caob23/dsh-browser-control。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Run code in subprocesses and return concise results, or index long material in local SQLite FTS5 for search.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在子进程执行代码并返回精简结果，或把长材料存入本地 SQLite FTS5 供检索。

description.en: ★ 33 │ Session-state notification plugin for the dsh web GUI: session completed/failed, question-asked, and permission-requested alerts with configurable built-in or custom sounds and browser notifications, plus a Notifications settings section
description.zh: ★ 33 │ 为会话完成、失败、提问和权限请求配置声音与浏览器通知。

description.en: ★ 3 │ DeepSeek Harness billing plugin: shows account balance and this session's billed spend, with a session-header badge.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 显示账户余额和当前会话的实际计费金额，在会话标题旁提供费用标记。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read-only Git and SVN change preview for DSH.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 面向 DSH 的只读 Git 与 SVN 变更预览。

description.en: ★ 6 │ DSH web search provider chosen by vendor and protocol: Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages with built-in search tools, plus standalone search APIs.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 为网页搜索选择供应商和接口协议，支持模型内置搜索及独立搜索 API。

description.en: ★ 47 │ Manage chapter drafting, setting constraints, repetition checks and whole-book reviews.

description.en: ★ 1 │ A persistent tmux control-mode panel in DSH Web that attaches to existing tmux sessions, stays visible across chats and adapts to phones.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH Web 中常驻的 tmux 控制模式工作台，连接已有的 tmux 会话，切换聊天时保持可见，并适配手机。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Links pet-whale and dsh-whale-widget: when the desk pet nears the widget it pretends to work and turns toward it, and the widget greets it with a default bubble, without modifying either plugin's source.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 连接桌宠与余额鲸鱼挂件，让两者靠近时触发转身、假装工作和气泡互动。

description.en: ★ 29 │ Connect ChatGPT subscription models using locally stored Codex CLI sign-in credentials.
description.zh: ★ 29 │ 复用本机 Codex CLI 登录凭据，为 DSH 接入 ChatGPT 订阅模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect the wensu stdio MCP server for read-only CNKI and Web of Science bibliographic search, details, export and status, without full-text downloads. Requires Windows, Python 3.11+, wensu on PATH, and a separately configured Edge or Chrome extension and native host. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 接入文溯 stdio MCP，提供知网与 Web of Science 只读题录检索、详情、导出与状态查询，不下载全文。需要 Windows、Python 3.11+、PATH 中的 wensu 命令，并另行配置 Edge/Chrome 扩展和原生宿主。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Authorize a browser-local directory and let agent tools read or write it through a private WebSocket relay.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在浏览器授权本地目录，通过私有 WebSocket 通道让 Agent 工具读写其中的文件。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness, where the model writes the interface in DIL (Markdown, JSX-like tags, JavaScript). The host compiles it, and a sandboxed runtime renders interactive text and rich cards.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将模型编写的 DIL 界面编译为交互文字和卡片，在沙箱中运行。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Balance and spending of an arckep.ru account inside the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI. Unofficial community plugin.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面中显示 arckep.ru 账户的余额与消费。非官方社区插件。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Six features in one bundle, including a transparent, always-on-top desktop pet from codex-pets.net and a global wallpaper from wallhaven.cc or a local image.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供桌宠、壁纸等六项功能，可使用 codex-pets.net 角色、wallhaven.cc 壁纸或本地图片。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness pill showing whether the selected DeepSeek or z.ai billing plan is in a peak or off-peak (half-price) window right now, with a click-to-open schedule panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 显示当前 DeepSeek 或 z.ai 套餐所处的峰谷计费时段，点击查看时段表。

description.en: ★ 1 │ BuilderHUD — vitals-cluster skins for the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为侧栏添加 BuilderHUD 状态皮肤，显示仪表、徽章和实时 Token 消耗。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Browse workspaces and sessions as draggable bubbles, with search, filters, saved browser layouts and native rename, new-session, archive and restore actions. Dragging changes layout only. Tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 用可拖动气泡浏览工作区与会话，支持搜索筛选、浏览器本地布局保存，以及重命名、新建会话、归档和恢复。拖拽只调整图谱布局，已测试 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Authorize FlowUs through browser OAuth and expose its official MCP tools as native agent tools.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过浏览器 OAuth 授权 FlowUs，把官方 MCP 工具接为 Agent 原生工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show provider balances and usage quotas, including ChatGPT subscription usage through dsh-codex-auth, with automatic refresh and per-session model selection.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 显示供应商余额与用量额度，支持通过 dsh-codex-auth 查看 ChatGPT 订阅用量，自动刷新并跟随当前会话所选模型。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Pando desktop pet for the DSH UI, a replica of the confirmo.love companion with a local sprite directory and community sprites. Drag to move and right-click to switch sprites.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 添加 Pando 桌宠，支持本地及社区精灵图，拖动位置、右键切换角色。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI: registers 日本語 and provides ja dictionaries for all dsh-web-all family plugin namespaces.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 网页界面及 dsh-web-all 系列插件提供日语翻译。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Edit multilingual writing, coordinate long-form drafts and inspect DSH delegation tools on demand. Requires Python 3.9+.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 多语言润色、长文分块协作与上下文一致性审查，按需检查 DSH 智能体委派工具。需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Claude Code Desktop theme for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — visual & interaction overhaul
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 网页应用 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，调整视觉与交互。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Explain the consequences of extra-permission requests in full-access mode, with confidence and inspection scope.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在完全权限下分析额外授权请求的影响，并标注置信度与已检查范围。

description.en: ★ 996 │ Search the web and X, fetch page content, and switch between search engines when a request fails.
description.zh: ★ 996 │ 搜索网页和 X 内容、抓取正文，并在请求失败时切换搜索引擎。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect QQ via NapCat or OneBot 11 to a DSH session, with access controls and QQ tools. Requires a separately configured gateway and Node ^22.19 or >=24; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 NapCat 或 OneBot 11 将 QQ 接入 DSH 会话，提供访问控制和 QQ 工具。需单独配置网关、Node ^22.19 或 >=24；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 30 │ Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 30 │ 通过钉钉连接 DSH 会话与消息。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DPK manager for DeepSeek Harness: pack, verify and install local DSH plugin packages (.dpk) from the Plugins-page panel and the in-session dpk tool.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在插件页或会话中打包、校验和安装本地 .dpk 插件包。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Connect QQ groups and private chats to DSH through NapCat, with chat memory, media and scheduled replies. Requires NapCat, a shared token and Node >=22.12; private chats default to workspace-write and groups to read-only.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 通过 NapCat 将 QQ 群聊和私聊接入 DSH，支持记忆、图片文件与主动回复。需另配 NapCat、共享 Token 和 Node >=22.12；私聊默认 workspace-write，群聊默认只读。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Add project memory, task planning and verification to DSH, plus AgenticReplay to record and export model and tool activity.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 添加项目记忆、任务规划和验证支持，并可用 AgenticReplay 记录、导出模型和工具活动。

description.en: ★ 1 │ A visual project workspace for goals, source material, module conversations, revisions and versioned deliverables, with bundled Python for document processing. For Windows x64 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.5; model work uses the account configured in DSH.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 把目标、资料、模块会话、修订和版本化成果放进同一画布，并内置 Python 处理文档。适用于 Windows x64 和 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5；模型任务使用 DSH 中已配置的账号。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: inventories your Windows dev/test toolchain, spots the gaps, and fills them with one click.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 检查 Windows 开发和测试工具链，找出并补齐缺失组件。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: delete an archived session's local files (transcript, projection cache and its subagent sessions) after a two-step confirmation.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 经两步确认后，删除已归档会话的本地记录、缓存及关联子 Agent 会话。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Define specialist agent roles in YAML, each with its own prompt, model, skills and permissions, run them together as multi-agent graphs, and keep what they learn across sessions. Also works with OpenCode, Pi and Codex.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 用 YAML 定义专职 Agent 角色，各自配置提示词、模型、技能和权限，按多 Agent 流程协作，并跨会话保留经验。也支持 OpenCode、Pi 和 Codex。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Incrementally mirror individual DSH session logs, preview fuzzy-match restores and optionally clean expired backups. Defaults to ~/.dsh/sessions and E:\DshChatBackup; configure a usable backup destination. Automatic cleanup is off by default.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 逐会话增量镜像 DSH 日志，支持模糊匹配恢复预览和可选的过期备份清理。默认读取 ~/.dsh/sessions，备份到 E:\DshChatBackup，使用前请配置可用目录；自动清理默认关闭。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Group sidebar sessions inside each workspace, import or export groups, and create sessions from a workspace or group. The package declares DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0 and needs the Web UI. Without the host connection service, local requests can read or replace group metadata.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将工作区侧栏会话分组，支持导入导出及从工作区或分组新建会话。包内声明 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0，需 Web 界面；宿主连接服务不可用时，本机请求可读取或替换分组数据。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Display DeepSeek account balance and estimated session cost below the composer. Requires a configured DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框下显示 DeepSeek 余额和会话费用估算，需要配置 DeepSeek API Key。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Store project and user memories as local Markdown with management, imports, backups and merge history. Automatic model summaries and topic merging are enabled by default; session material goes to the configured model and may incur charges. Requires Node ^22.19 or >=24 and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <1.0.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 以本地 Markdown 保存项目与用户记忆，提供管理、导入、备份和合并历史。默认开启模型自动总结与主题合并，会将会话材料发给所选模型并可能产生费用。需 Node ^22.19 或 >=24 和 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <1.0.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin adding two code-quality skills: /simplify (behavior-preserving cleanups of the current diff) and /code-review (multi-angle review).
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供 /simplify 和 /code-review 技能，清理当前改动并进行多角度代码审查。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Learn and revise a user profile across conversations, preserving original memories and distilling experiences into layered summaries for selective recall. Data stays in profile-local SQLite; summarization uses the model. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, Node >=24 and Hindsight for semantic recall.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 跨会话学习并修正用户画像，保留原始记忆，将重要经历提炼为分层摘要并按相关性召回。数据保存在当前 profile 的本地 SQLite，提炼使用模型。需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、Node >=24，语义召回需 Hindsight 服务。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Mirror DSH sessions, messages and tool activity to a JARVIS Mission Control board, where finished turns wait for human review.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 把 DSH 会话、消息和工具活动同步到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，完成的回合交给人工审核。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the DeepSeek API account balance, shown beside Settings at the sidebar foot.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部的设置按钮旁显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额。

description.en: ★ 0 │ General usage stats for DeepSeek Harness: throughput, tokens, cost, tool calls, and activity, charted in the Web UI. A TypeScript superset of dsh-plugin-tokspeed.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用图表展示吞吐量、Token、费用、工具调用和活跃情况，扩展自 dsh-plugin-tokspeed。

description.en: ★ 12 │ Register Superpowers development skills and session guidance with the DSH skills and prompt services.
description.zh: ★ 12 │ 接入 Superpowers 开发技能，并向会话提示词添加使用引导。

description.en: Full-featured Mem0 integration for DSH: auto-recall, consolidation, 7 tools, influence scores, provenance, and a trace viewer.
description.zh: 通过 Mem0 自动召回和整理记忆，提供来源追溯、影响评分和记录查看。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Import and play local audio with a spectrum display, persistent library and configurable shortcuts. Audio stays in browser IndexedDB; decoding depends on the browser’s supported formats. Requires the DSH web UI; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 导入并播放本地音频，提供频谱、持久曲库和可自定义快捷键。音频保存在浏览器 IndexedDB，格式支持取决于浏览器解码能力。需 DSH Web 界面，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A full-featured CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) provider plugin.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 功能完整的 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）提供方插件。

description.en: ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness, with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 ZPDF 工具，支持 API 密钥保存和命令行配置。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH bundle: push Bark notifications to iPhone and Apple Watch when an agent finishes a run, needs approval, or errors out.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在任务完成、需要审批或出错时，通过 Bark 通知 iPhone 和 Apple Watch。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: the model draws vector figures inline between reply paragraphs, so answers read as text, figure, text.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 让模型在回复段落之间插入矢量图示，结合文字解释内容。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH toolbox bundle: one plugin installs five features, each with its own switch: delete conversations, regenerate from here, the /teammate command, cross-session reminders, and auto-naming after the first turn. The plugin page shows one card with five component rows.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 组合提供删除会话、重新生成、/teammate、跨会话提醒和自动命名，各项可独立开关。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show workspaces as books and conversations as chapters, with searchable covers and a switch back to the original workspace view. Cover preferences are stored in the browser.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将工作区显示为书本、会话显示为章节，支持搜索、编辑封面并切回原版工作区。封面偏好保存在浏览器中。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Rewrite the composer draft in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app with work, code and design modes, and restore the original text with one click.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的输入栏改写提示词，提供日常办公、代码开发和设计创意三种模式，支持一键还原原文。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用关系图审阅代码改动，点击节点即可跳转到相应源码行。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A draggable, collapsible Minesweeper overlay with configurable board size. Game state stays in memory and resets when the page reloads.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 可拖动、可折叠的扫雷浮层，支持调整棋盘与雷数；状态仅保存在内存，刷新后重置。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness bundle: aligns the Markdown pipe tables touched by each write or edit, and reports what changed.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 自动对齐写入或编辑的 Markdown 表格，并说明改动内容。

description.en: ★ 37 │ Organize workspace navigation by disk paths with optional name-based grouping.
description.zh: ★ 37 │ 按磁盘目录组织工作区导航，并可启用名称分组。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Adds Soniox speech-to-text and text-to-speech through your own API key. Recordings and text to synthesize are sent to Soniox; generated audio is cached locally under DSH_HOME. Requires a Soniox key and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 使用自己的 API Key 接入 Soniox 语音识别与合成。录音和待朗读文本会发送到 Soniox，生成的音频缓存在本机 DSH_HOME。需要 Soniox Key 和 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: Mark DSH sidebar conversations with a tinted background, a colored dot at the row's end, and a per-conversation title size.
description.zh: 为侧栏会话设置背景色、彩色标记和标题字号。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Hide the DeepSeek Harness sidebar logo, brand name, version and conversation hero fish using empty brand slots and CSS. Author-tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1; no compatibility range is declared. This is the renamed package; the old remove-deepseek-logo name is deprecated.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过空品牌插槽与样式隐藏 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏标志、品牌名、版本和对话首页鲸鱼。作者验证 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1；未声明兼容范围。这是更名后的包，旧名 remove-deepseek-logo 已弃用。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Download a time range of a video with yt-dlp, extract frames to check the cut, and optionally share the file as a local HTTP download. Share paths are bounded with realpath so symlinks and directory junctions cannot escape the share root. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0, Node >=22, and a local yt-dlp/ffmpeg toolchain.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用 yt-dlp 按时间区间下载视频、抽帧核对边界，并可把成片分享为本地 HTTP 下载。分享路径用 realpath 做真实边界检查，符号链接和目录联接不能逃出共享根目录。需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0、Node >=22，以及本机 yt-dlp/ffmpeg 工具链。

description.en: ★ 91 │ Analyze the workspace, explain its architecture, keep decisions and TODOs, and restore project context in later sessions, with optional hybrid retrieval.
description.zh: ★ 91 │ 分析当前工作区、讲解项目架构、保存开发决策和待办，并在后续会话中恢复项目上下文，可选混合检索。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Preview recovery context from local Codex chats and insert it into the DSH draft for manual sending. Requires Python 3; compressed logs also need zstd.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 预览本机 Codex 聊天的恢复上下文并插入 DSH 草稿，由用户自行发送。需 Python 3，压缩日志还需 zstd。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Extract, search, translate and review game text, with model delegation and verified writes into an independent copy. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3, Node.js >=24.9 and Python 3.10+. The Windows native UI also needs .NET Framework 4.8 and WebView2 Runtime; model calls consume tokens.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 提取、检索、翻译和审校游戏文本，支持多模型委托及独立副本写回核验。需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3、Node.js >=24.9 和 Python 3.10+；Windows 原生界面还需 .NET Framework 4.8 与 WebView2 Runtime，模型调用消耗 token。

description.en: ★ 1 │ A job-hunting workbench for profiles, target roles, resume analysis and rewriting, text and realtime voice mock interviews, and DOCX/PDF report exports. Text uses the host model; realtime voice uses the host's settings and credential service. All /zhijing routes go through connection.requestRejection(). Development preview pinned by Git commit; requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=24.9.0. MIT.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 求职工作台：管理个人资料与目标岗位，简历分析与改写，文字和实时语音模拟面试，并导出 DOCX/PDF 报告。文字使用宿主模型，实时语音通过宿主设置与凭据服务配置。/zhijing 接口全部先走 connection.requestRejection()。开发预览版，按 Git 提交固定；需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=24.9.0。MIT 许可。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Customize DSH colors, fonts, corners, header, composer, message styles and local image or video backgrounds. Preferences and imported media stay in the browser; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 自由组合 DSH 配色、字体、圆角、顶栏、输入框、消息样式及本地图片或视频背景。偏好和导入媒体保存在浏览器中；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Jizuo Video: standalone video projects, novel-adaptation scripts, and video editing.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 即作视频：独立视频项目、小说改编剧本与视频编辑。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Adjust reasoning effort from the model menu, including suggested levels for models without declared efforts. Availability depends on provider support; requires Node >=22, with no DSH compatibility range declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在模型菜单调整推理等级，为未声明档位的模型提供建议档位；实际生效取决于提供商支持，需要 Node >=22，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show workflow stages and subagents on a timeline, configure model and concurrency for each stage, and reopen subagent conversations from the panel. Run names and stage settings persist under ~/.dsh; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在时间线中查看工作流阶段和子代理，为每个阶段配置模型与并发，并从面板打开子代理对话。运行名称与阶段设置保存在 ~/.dsh，需要 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: Build a local tool index, preselect one clear match and discover deferred tools on demand. Calls keep the active DSH step tool set and host execution path; declares DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 compatibility.
description.zh: 为工具建立本地索引，明确命中时预选工具，其余按需搜索调用。调用保留当前 DSH 步骤的工具集与宿主执行流程，声明兼容 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show your DeepSeek wallet balance at the foot of the sidebar, refreshed after each turn, with an animated change. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; supports DSH 0.1.7 and 0.2.0 only.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在侧栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每轮结束后刷新，金额变化时有动画。需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，仅支持 DSH 0.1.7 和 0.2.0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Replace the send/stop button with an animated DeepSeek whale that follows the running state. Supports dark themes and reduced motion; tested on macOS with DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将发送和停止按钮换成随运行状态游动的 DeepSeek 鲸鱼，支持深色主题及减少动态效果。作者实测 macOS、DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Predict the next user message as ghost text after a reply. Tab or Right Arrow inserts a draft without sending. Uses the configured model and may incur inference costs; requires Node >=22.12, with no DSH range declared.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 回复结束后以灰色文字预测下一句，按 Tab 或右箭头只填入草稿；使用配置的模型并可能产生调用费用，需要 Node >=22.12，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Drive the official Windows ego lite app from DeepSeek Harness over authenticated loopback HTTP: create task spaces, navigate, read snapshots, click, fill and take screenshots. Requires Windows and the official Ego CLI installed locally; screenshots are saved to the desktop. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过带认证的本机回环连接，让 DeepSeek Harness 操作官方 Windows 版 ego lite：创建任务空间、导航、读取快照、点击、填写与截图。需 Windows 并在本机安装官方 Ego CLI，截图保存到桌面。需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Summarize Git commits and changed lines across workspaces and generate daily, weekly or monthly reports, optionally limited to your own Git identity. Runs local Git commands; optional plugin updates use the configured npm registry. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 统计各工作区的 Git 提交与变更行数，按全部作者或本人身份生成日报、周报和月报。使用本机 Git，可选从配置的 npm 源检查并更新插件；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Organize personal todos on a dated sticky-note wall in the sidebar. Todo data stays in browser localStorage. Requires the DSH web UI; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 从侧栏打开按日期排列的个人待办便签墙，待办保存在浏览器 localStorage。需要 DSH Web 界面，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Quote selected chat text or file previews into the current draft, add a comment, or open a side question. Side questions require @xywen97/dsh-sidechat.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把选中的聊天文字或文件预览加入当前输入框草稿，可添加评论或发起侧边提问；侧边提问需要 @xywen97/dsh-sidechat。

description.en: ★ 23 │ A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent can define, assert against, and query under schema constraints.
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 用类型和规则定义领域知识，保存事实并进行查询和推理。

description.en: ★ 1 │ View OpenCode Go subscription allowances, model usage and rates from the sidebar, and connect an API key through authenticated DSH routes. Queries OpenCode services and stores the key on the host. Requires an OpenCode Go account; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在侧栏查看 OpenCode Go 订阅额度、模型用量和价格，并通过已认证的 DSH 接口连接 API Key。会查询 OpenCode 服务，密钥保存在宿主端。需 OpenCode Go 账号，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Select passages in replies, attach questions and combine them into a numbered follow-up. Annotations stay in browser storage until the user sends them as ordinary conversation text. Requires the web UI and Node >=20; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 划选回答片段并附上问题，汇总为带编号的追问。标注保存在浏览器，发送后才作为普通会话文本交给模型。需 Web 界面、Node >=20，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 33 │ DSH pure Plan B plugin bundle: .dspack export/import with multiple profiles, zero changes to official source, zero third-party plugins.
description.zh: ★ 33 │ 导出和导入 .dspack 插件包，支持多个 Profile，无需修改 DSH 官方源码。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Review tool requests that need to run outside the sandbox, retaining sandbox restrictions and denying automatic approval if review fails.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 只复核需要在沙箱外执行的工具请求，保留原有沙箱限制；审查失败时不自动放行。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Browse SkillHub, install and manage local skills, and enable, disable or remove MCP servers. Desktop profile required; MCP removal writes a backup before editing the profile.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 浏览 SkillHub、安装和管理本地技能，支持启停或移除 MCP 服务。需桌面 profile；移除 MCP 前会备份 profile 配置。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show uncommitted changes and the local commit history of one or more Git repositories in the current DSH workspace, with per-file line counts and unified diffs. Read-only; uses a temporary Git index and does not stage, commit or push.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 显示当前 DSH 工作区中一个或多个 Git 仓库的未提交改动和本地提交历史，支持逐文件增删行数与统一差异。只读；使用临时 Git 索引，不执行 stage、commit 或 push。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage a password and Cloudflare Turnstile login page for a protected DSH instance. Full protection requires the separate Node gateway, HTTPS reverse proxy and blocked direct access to DSH; installing this settings plugin alone does not enable the gateway. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为受保护的 DSH 实例管理密码与 Cloudflare Turnstile 登录页面。完整门禁需另行部署 Node 网关、HTTPS 反向代理并禁止直接访问 DSH，仅安装设置插件不会启用网关。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Add an optional reason to tool approval rejections and include it in the failed tool result for the model. Keeps subagent approval behavior unchanged.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在工具权限审批中填写可选的拒绝原因，随失败的工具结果交给模型；子智能体沿用宿主审批行为。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Connect a personal WHOOP account to view recovery, strain, sleep and workout trends. Requires a WHOOP developer app, Client ID/Secret, an HTTPS OAuth callback and Node >=24.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 连接个人 WHOOP 账号，查看恢复、负荷、睡眠和训练趋势；需自行创建 WHOOP 开发者应用、配置 Client ID/Secret 与 HTTPS OAuth 回调，需要 Node >=24。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Annotate sidebar pages or document previews with region captures or selected text, then add the location and note to the current conversation draft. Browser page capture needs the desktop webview; the author tested DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 on Windows.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 对侧栏网页或文档预览进行区域截图或选中文字批注，将位置与说明加入当前对话草稿。网页截图需要桌面 webview；作者在 Windows 的 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 上验证。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Mark conversation messages, search them across sessions and jump back to their source. Marks are stored in the local browser.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 标记对话消息，在侧栏跨会话搜索并跳回原文；标记保存在本地浏览器。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Windows notifications when a session turn ends, with optional foreground suppression and subagent filtering. Requires notification permission.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 会话回合结束时发送 Windows 通知，可设前台免打扰和子代理过滤，需允许系统通知。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Translate a business goal into a validated workflow blueprint and export Markdown or JSON runbooks. It plans required tools, permissions, acceptance and rollback without running the workflow. Requires Node >=20 and DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将业务目标整理为可校验的工作流蓝图，列出工具、权限、验收与回滚，并导出 Markdown 或 JSON 运行手册；只生成计划。需 Node >=20 和 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Provide 38 vendored Matt Pocock skills in DSH, preserving manual-only and model-invocable policies. This fixed Git package is distinct from similarly named npm packages; requires Node >=20.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 提供 38 个内置 Matt Pocock 技能，保留手动专用和模型可调用的区分；使用固定 Git 来源，与同类 npm 包区分，需要 Node >=20。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add a Foxy persona as a DSH agent preset while keeping the native conversation runtime. Choose a model in DSH; persistent memory requires the separate dsh-foxy-memory plugin.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 增加 Foxy 人物预设，复用原生会话运行时。模型由用户在 DSH 中选择，持久记忆需另装 dsh-foxy-memory。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compact session sidebar with project groups, search, unread markers, reversible organization, metadata backup and an original-layout switch. Adapts the native workspace module with a fallback; author tested Windows and Linux Web on selected DSH 0.1.7–0.2.2 prereleases.
