description.zh: ★ 0 │ 紧凑会话侧栏，支持项目分组、搜索、未读提示、可恢复整理、列表元数据备份及原布局切换。增强宿主原生工作区模块，不兼容时回退；作者在 Windows、Linux Web 验证了部分 DSH 0.1.7 至 0.2.2 预发布版。

description.en: ★ 105 │ View DSH sessions, chat and approve individual actions from a phone. Remote access requires a separately secured relay; notifications, Web Push and GitHub starring are optional configured network actions.
description.zh: ★ 105 │ 在手机查看会话、聊天和逐次审批；远程访问需另配受保护的中继，可选通知、Web Push 和 GitHub 授权。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Bind ContextGraph project memory to the agent: recall before work, write a handoff after work, and report freshness without false alarms. Stores data locally and reads git project info. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把 ContextGraph 项目记忆接入 Agent：开工前回忆、收工后写交接，并给出不过度报警的新鲜度提示。数据保存在本机，会读取 git 项目信息。未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Quote earlier turns of the current conversation through the @ menu: a single turn, a whole Q&A turn, or the last few turns, with body search. Adds a reference to the draft without deleting or rewinding conversation history. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 @ 菜单引用当前会话中更早的轮次：单轮、整段问答，或最近几轮，并支持正文搜索。将原文作为引用加入草稿，不删除或回退会话历史。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Finds duplicate, similar and large files in local WeChat storage and moves the ones you confirm into a restorable trash folder instead of deleting them. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or later within 0.2 and Node 20+.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 扫描本机微信文件目录里的重复、相似和大文件，确认后移入可一键恢复的隔离区，不直接删除。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 及以上的 0.2 版本和 Node 20+。

description.en: ★ 34 │ Feishu/Lark bridge for local coding agents — one group, one conversation, one pinned runtime. Bridges dsh, CLI agents (traex/codex), an IDE window, or a custom agent behind one gateway.
description.zh: ★ 34 │ 通过飞书群组连接本机 DSH、编程命令行或 IDE 助手。

description.en: ★ 28 │ MuseAI tavern for the dsh web GUI: a MuseAI conversation-view tab (right of Trajectory) with background / chat / adventure / bond / settings pages ported from MuseAI, running entirely on models configured in DeepSeek Harness (no separate API config)
description.zh: ★ 28 │ 在 DSH 模型配置上运行带聊天、冒险与角色页面的 MuseAI 界面。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add workspace file references and selected preview text to the composer. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将工作区文件和预览中选中的文字引用到输入框。要求 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Install and route the YottaMeta skill family, packaged with an MCP server.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 安装并调度 YottaMeta 技能家族，内置 MCP 服务器。

description.en: ★ 0 │ An optional writing mode with a right-sidebar panel for title, characters, world, style, length, chapters and branches, plus a cross-chapter context pack. /api/writer-studio/* is registered only when the host connection service is available, and every request goes through connection.requestRejection(). Git pin at v0.4.2. MIT.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 可选写作模式，右侧栏管理书名、角色、世界观、文风、字数、章节与分支，并提供跨章上下文包。仅在宿主 connection 服务可用时注册 /api/writer-studio/*，每条请求先走 connection.requestRejection()。Git 固定在 v0.4.2。MIT 许可。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add an animated rainbow border to the message composer. Respects reduced-motion preferences; requires the host composer selector and modern CSS support.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为消息输入框添加流动彩虹描边，遵循减弱动态效果设置；依赖宿主输入框选择器和现代 CSS 支持。

description.en: ★ 26 │ Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: multi-channel retrieval and an evolving memory store.
description.zh: ★ 26 │ 通过多通道检索维护和召回长期记忆。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Turn reusable project knowledge or imported Markdown into proposed skills, review them and publish approved versions to project or global catalogs. Stores data under DSH_HOME/skill-compiler; session auto-approval is optional and explicitly enabled. Uses DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 packages; Spanish and English UI.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将项目中的可复用知识或导入的 Markdown 整理成技能草案，审阅后发布到项目或全局技能目录。数据保存在 DSH_HOME/skill-compiler；会话自动批准需主动开启。依赖 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 系列包，界面支持西班牙语和英语。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Create, tag, search and edit local Markdown card notes, with optional organization through the DSH model. Uses a portable library shared with other slipbox-capable agents; model-assisted work sends the relevant notes to that model. Requires Python >=3.10 and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 创建、标记、搜索和编辑本地 Markdown 卡片，可交给 DSH 模型整理，并与其他支持 slipbox 的智能体复用资料库。模型整理会发送相关笔记上下文；需 Python >=3.10、DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Before git commit, git push or gh repo sync runs through DSH, scan the content that would be committed or uploaded for keys, private keys, credentials, absolute paths and personal data. Suspicious content requires one-time approval, with global, project and session allow lists and a settings page behind DSH host authentication. Manual terminals outside DSH are not covered.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH 执行 git commit、git push 或 gh repo sync 前，只读检查将要提交或上传的密钥、私钥、凭据、绝对路径和个人信息。发现内容时请求一次性授权，支持全局、项目和会话三级放行名单，设置页使用 DSH 宿主认证。不覆盖 DSH 之外的人工终端操作。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read text from PNG and JPEG images locally with the ocr_image tool. OCR models and native runtime are bundled; currently Windows x64 only. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0 and can use substantial memory.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用 ocr_image 工具在本机识别 PNG、JPEG 中的文字，随包提供模型与原生运行库。目前仅支持 Windows x64，需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0，处理大图可能占用较多内存。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Improve the DSH Web shell on phones: narrow-screen layout fixes, iOS keyboard and viewport handling, and single-tap session switching. Client-only; remote access still uses DSH's own tokenized web address. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 优化手机上的 DSH Web 壳层：窄屏布局修正、iOS 键盘与视口处理、单击切换会话。仅前端插件，远程访问仍使用 DSH 自带的带令牌网址。未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read local Codex threads in a DSH sidebar and bind transcripts to a DSH session. Needs a Node runtime with node:sqlite and local Codex history; Explorer reveal is Windows-only.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH 侧栏浏览本机 Codex 线程，将转录绑定到 DSH 会话。需支持 node:sqlite 的 Node 运行时与本地 Codex 历史；资源管理器定位仅 Windows。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Search, run and build Apify Actors from DSH through the Apify MCP server and skills. Running Actors needs APIFY_TOKEN; the development skills need the Apify CLI.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 通过 Apify MCP 服务器和技能，在 DSH 中搜索、运行和开发 Apify Actor。运行 Actor 需要 APIFY_TOKEN，开发类技能需要 Apify CLI。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Set token, estimated cost and elapsed-time caps for DSH goals and block continuation when a cap is reached, with a per-model breakdown. Price accuracy depends on configured models and rates; automatic currency detection queries the official DeepSeek balance endpoint. Requires Node >=22 and declares DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH Goal 设置 token、估算费用和运行时长上限，超限阻止续跑，并按模型展示明细。费用准确度取决于模型与价格配置；自动币种识别会查询 DeepSeek 官方余额接口。需 Node >=22，声明兼容 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show Windows desktop popups when a session finishes or needs an answer or approval, with optional sound and click-to-return. Uses a bundled PowerShell/WPF helper and includes local conversation previews.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 会话完成或等待回答、审批时弹出 Windows 桌面提醒，可选声音并点击返回会话。通过随包 PowerShell/WPF 辅助程序显示，会包含本机会话摘要。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Generate white, pink and brown noise, rain and fan sounds with Web Audio, with volume, waveform visualization and a sleep timer. Audio is synthesized in the browser; requires the DSH web UI.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 Web Audio 合成白噪、粉噪、棕噪、雨声与风扇声，提供音量、波形和定时淡出。声音在浏览器生成，需要 DSH Web 界面。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Open the official chat.deepseek.com web chat in the built-in browser tab from a sidebar icon, with a system-browser fallback. Conversations stay on chat.deepseek.com; the plugin stores and proxies nothing.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 从侧栏图标把官方 chat.deepseek.com 网页版打开到内置浏览器标签，也可改用系统浏览器。对话仍留在 chat.deepseek.com，插件不存储也不代理任何内容。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Expand the conversation turn rail, preview prompt summaries and edit local navigation labels. Display preferences and custom labels stay in browser localStorage. Requires the DSH web UI and depends on its conversation DOM; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 切换加大的会话轮次导航条，预览提问摘要并编辑本地导航标签。显示偏好和标签保存在浏览器 localStorage，需 DSH Web 界面并依赖会话 DOM；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Replace the thinking-status text with rotating bilingual phrases and an editable local word pool. Depends on host DOM markers; use it instead of other plugins that replace the same status text.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 把思考状态文案换成轮换的双语短句，词池可编辑并保存在浏览器。依赖宿主 DOM 标记，与修改同一状态文案的插件需二选一。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Literature search for DeepSeek Harness using the official PubMed NCBI E-utilities API (esearch, esummary, efetch, elink) and Google Scholar via SerpApi or direct HTML parsing.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过 PubMed 官方 API 和 Google Scholar 检索文献，后者可用 SerpApi 或网页解析。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read an Obsidian vault, import documents, annotate and take Markdown notes, with companion conversations and local Whisper transcription. PDF/Office conversion and transcription need separately configured local tools; model conversations use DSH.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 阅读 Obsidian 仓库、导入文档、批注并保存 Markdown 笔记，支持伴读对话和本机 Whisper 转写。PDF/Office 转换与转写需另配本地工具，伴读使用 DSH 模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Make sidebar navigation, projects and sessions share a scroll area. Replaces the sidebar presentation; use one sidebar replacement at a time. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and Node >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 让侧栏菜单、项目和会话共用滚动区。会替换侧栏展示组件，请同时只启用一个侧栏替换插件；需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3、Node >=24。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Import local Codex conversations into DSH sessions with optional automatic sync. Requires local Codex data; macOS and Linux supported, Windows untested.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将本机 Codex 对话导入 DSH 会话，可选自动同步；需要本地 Codex 数据，支持 macOS 和 Linux，Windows 未测试。

description.en: ★ 21 │ Creative branching canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 在树状创意画布中生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Add a smoothly moving comet cursor to the chat composer with configurable trails, colors, and thickness.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 为聊天输入框添加平滑移动的彗星光标，可调整拖尾、颜色与粗细。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A leaner fork of the DeepSeek balance whale for DSH Desktop: a status bar above the whale shows balance, grants, top-ups, today’s spend and the peak/off-peak timeline, with separately configurable automatic bubbles and sounds. All routes require DSH host authentication.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼的简洁分支，适用于 DSH 桌面端：鲸鱼头顶常驻余额、赠金、充值余额、今日已用和峰谷时间线，自动提示泡泡与音效可分别设置。所有接口都需要 DSH 宿主认证。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Customize the order, names and icons of Settings navigation through your own DSH configuration; the public defaults contain no author rules. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 通过个人 DSH 配置定制设置导航的顺序、名称和图标，公共默认不含作者规则。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Structure exam mathematics problems, check candidate solutions and estimate rubric scores. Results are not formal proofs or authoritative grading; requires Node >=22.19.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按考试要求组织数学题、核对候选解答并预测步骤分；结果不是形式化证明或权威评分，需要 Node >=22.19。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Display session token usage and estimated DeepSeek cost beneath the composer. Public holidays are not modelled; no DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框下显示会话 token 用量和 DeepSeek 费用估算；未计算法定节假日，未声明 DSH 版本范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Start a local TensorBoard scalar dashboard from a DSH tool: pick primary and secondary metrics, set the improvement direction and optional EMA smoothing for existing training logs. Read-only; requires Python 3.10+ and TensorBoard.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 DSH 工具启动本地 TensorBoard 标量监控页，可选主要和辅助指标、改善方向与 EMA 平滑，查看已有训练日志。只读取日志，需要 Python 3.10+ 和 TensorBoard。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Annotate images in the native sidebar and send originals, numbered references and feedback to the current conversation without replacing its draft. Disable the legacy local bundle before migrating.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在原生侧栏标注图片，将原图、编号参考图和反馈发送到当前会话，保留输入草稿。迁移前需禁用旧版本地插件。

description.en: ★ 40 │ Generate and edit images locally with ComfyUI and Qwen-Image. Requires a configured Python/ComfyUI environment, models and a compatible GPU; acceleration dependency installation is enabled by default. Keep DSH Web and ComfyUI on trusted loopback interfaces; remote exposure needs additional authentication.
description.zh: ★ 40 │ 通过 ComfyUI 和 Qwen-Image 在本机生成、重绘图像。需配置 Python/ComfyUI、模型及兼容显卡；加速依赖自动安装默认开启。DSH Web 与 ComfyUI 应保持可信本机回环访问，远程开放前需补充身份校验。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Pick and preview stickers by emotion and collection. Uses your own image library and catalog; requires Node >=22 and Python 3.10+ or the DSH bundled Python. No DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按情绪和素材组挑选、预览表情包。需自备素材库与索引，并使用 Node >=22、Python 3.10+ 或 DSH 捆绑 Python；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Register the current executable to start at Windows login and remove its registry value when disabled. Use the fixed Git source; the same-name npm package is a separate project. Requires the desktop executable, with no restart watchdog.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将当前程序写入 Windows 登录自启动项，禁用时移除该注册表值；使用固定 Git 来源，同名 npm 包是其他项目。应在桌面程序中使用，不含崩溃重启守护。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Per-turn token usage and cost estimates, a usage page by model and session, and a 52-week activity heatmap for DSH Web. Costs are estimates; community sharing is off by default.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 为 DSH Web 显示每轮 Token 用量和费用估算，按模型和会话查看统计，并提供 52 周活动热力图。费用为估算值，社区数据分享默认关闭。

description.en: ★ 11 │ dsh plugin: registers custom agents defined in ~/.dsh/agents/*.md as callable subagents via the use_agent tool, with continuable background dispatch and ask_agent follow-ups.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 将本地 Markdown 文件定义的 Agent 注册为可调用子 Agent，支持后台任务续接和追问。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Connect CalDAV calendars to view, create, reschedule, and import events from DSH.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 连接 CalDAV 日历，在会话中查看、创建和调整日程，并导入日历文件。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Auto Title: keeps session titles following the latest task; names you set by hand stay put.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 随最新任务自动更新会话标题，保留手动设置的名称。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect a personal Weixin account for text, images and files; configure allowed senders before use. Uses a reverse-engineered protocol and can send proactive messages when enabled; consider a spare account. Requires Node >=22.13 and DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.4 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 接入个人微信的文字、图片和文件消息，使用前需配置允许的联系人。采用逆向协议，启用后可主动发消息，建议使用备用账号；需 Node >=22.13、DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.4 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Let long-running scripts report structured progress that DSH Web shows in a floating panel and a sidebar tab, without waiting for the command to finish.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 长时间运行的脚本可以上报结构化进度，在 DSH Web 的悬浮窗和右侧栏实时显示，不用等命令结束。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show the session's repository, branch, change count and short SHA above the composer; switch or create branches, list worktrees and open a per-file diff panel.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在输入框上方显示当前会话的仓库、分支、改动数和短 SHA，可切换或新建分支、查看工作树，并在侧栏逐文件查看差异。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Send DSH model requests through Sabi's local proxy, which picks the configured upstream model. Written against DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 把 DSH 的模型请求交给 Sabi 本地代理，由它按配置选择上游模型。基于 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 开发。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Inspect plugin runtime behavior and distinguish live configuration changes, restarts and hot reloads.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 诊断插件运行状态，区分实时配置生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Multi-host SSH tunnel and SSHManager tool for DeepSeek Harness, with project-scoped grants.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 管理多台主机的 SSH 隧道，并按项目授予连接权限。

description.en: ★ 10,458 │ Manage agent tasks, scheduled runs and execution state from the web interface.
description.zh: ★ 10,458 │ 在网页界面管理 Agent 任务、定时执行和运行状态。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Give the agent a make_slides tool that writes a self-contained HTML deck with speaker notes, which presents offline and prints to PDF, plus an optional editable PPTX.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供 make_slides 工具，生成可离线放映、带演讲备注并可打印为 PDF 的单文件 HTML 演示稿，也可导出可编辑的 PPTX。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Browse, preview, apply and revert color themes in DSH, including a palette matched to the default DSH colors. Sends limited usage events.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 在 DSH 中浏览、预览、应用和还原配色主题，包含与 DSH 默认配色一致的方案。会发送有限的使用统计。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Edit Markdown beside your files and DSH conversation, send selections to chat and reference notes with @mp. Includes rendered math, tables and footnotes, AI review, guarded saves and draft recovery. Requires host Connection authentication and built-in SQLite for local document sharing.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 将 Markdown、文件树和 DSH 对话并排，支持选区入对话、@mp 引用、公式、表格与脚注；提供 AI 修改审阅、版本守卫保存及草稿恢复。需提供 Connection 认证和内置 SQLite 的宿主运行时。

description.en: ★ 21 │ Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier with a Web settings page
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 通过网页设置配置 DSH 原生模型验证器。

description.en: ★ 105 │ Accessibility-first macOS Computer Use capability for DeepSeek Harness with stale-observation protection, app leases, confirmations, screenshots, and Web diagnostics
description.zh: ★ 105 │ 通过辅助功能、截图与应用控制工具操作 macOS 桌面。

description.en: ★ 728 │ A parody that dresses DSH up as a 2005 web portal with fake ads, pop-ups and a jackpot wheel. Answers keep generating in the background but wait for the ad to finish; ad slots link to real dsh-plugin repositories.
description.zh: ★ 728 │ 恶搞插件：把 DSH 变成 2005 年风格的门户网站，塞满假广告、弹窗和抽奖转盘。回答在后台照常生成，只是要等广告播完才显示；广告位会推荐真实的 dsh-plugin 仓库。

description.en: ★ 217 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex, as native subagents with live progress
description.zh: ★ 217 │ 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 调用 DSH 子 Agent，并查看实时进度。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Manage registered VPS hosts over SSH, with terminals, status commands, confirmation gates and file backups.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 通过 SSH 管理已登记的 VPS，提供终端、状态命令、操作确认和文件备份。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Adds input prediction to the DSH composer: suggests your next message after each turn (Tab to accept), and completes prefixes from session history as you type.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 在每轮结束后建议下一条消息，支持 Tab 采纳，并根据会话历史补全输入。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Read GitHub PRs, diffs, comments and CI, save local review drafts, and compare GitHub Release, npm and market publication states. Reuses an existing gh login; does not post reviews, comments or merges.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 只读查看 GitHub PR、差异、评论与 CI，保存本地评审草稿，并对照 GitHub Release、npm 与市场发布状态。复用已有 gh 登录，不发送评论、评审或合并请求。

description.en: ★ 20 │ DSH memory panel: browse, search, edit, and delete memories in Settings, and manually start or stop the local vector service.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在设置中浏览、搜索、编辑和删除记忆，并手动启停本地向量服务。

description.en: ★ 41 │ Detect repeated reasoning and output patterns and interrupt degenerate model calls.
description.zh: ★ 41 │ 检测重复思考与输出模式，中断陷入循环的模型调用。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Configure the OpenViking memory plugin, diagnose connections and tune session recall scope and injection settings.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 配置 OpenViking 记忆插件、诊断连接，并调整会话召回范围和注入参数。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Search PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv and preprints, format citations and read open-access full text. Claim checks retrieve matching passages for manual review.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 检索 PubMed、Europe PMC、arXiv 及预印本，生成引用并读取开放获取全文；引用核对基于词面匹配，需阅读原文确认。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage the skills DSH actually loads from Settings: see where each comes from, enable or disable it without touching its files, edit SKILL.md, and import or delete skills. Deletion is permanent.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在设置页管理 DSH 实际会加载的技能：查看来源和覆盖关系，不改文件即可启停，编辑 SKILL.md，导入或删除技能。删除后无法恢复。

description.en: ★ 11 │ Custom background image plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: upload a local picture or paste an image URL, shown behind the whole app with adjustable opacity.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为网页背景，可调节透明度。

description.en: ★ 8 │ A travel-planning mode that brings the Travel Story app (map, timeline, playback) into the DSH page, with the chat as a floating window and 18 agent tools for place search, weather, routes and itinerary editing. Place search needs your own Gaode (AMap) or LocationIQ key. Git pin at 3854a65; Node >=18. MIT.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 旅行规划模式：把 Travel Story 应用（地图、时间线、播放）整页带进 DSH，对话变为浮窗，提供 18 个 agent 工具覆盖地点搜索、天气、路线与行程编辑。地点搜索需自备高德或 LocationIQ Key。Git 固定在 3854a65；需 Node >=18。MIT 许可。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Use a planning agent to delegate work to a configured worker model and supervise workers with periodic checks. Calls go through native DSH subagents; workers and patrols use the configured model services. Author requirements: DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 and Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 由规划代理向配置的工作模型分派任务，并周期巡检、纠偏子代理。通过 DSH 原生子代理服务执行，任务和巡检使用配置的模型；作者要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3、Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Activate the shared AI provider registry and settings for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech and images. Install and activate this bundle before the Jina or Cohere provider; vendor packages and credentials are configured separately.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 启用语言模型、嵌入、重排序、语音与图像共用的 AI 提供方注册表和设置界面。使用 Jina 或 Cohere 插件前需先安装并启用本组合包，厂商插件与凭据另行配置。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show clickable follow-up prompts after each completed turn. Suggestions come from the current model or a separately selected model and are sent when you click a card. Optional separate generation reads that turn and consumes model quota; cards are saved in browser local storage.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 每轮回答结束后显示可点击的后续建议，由当前模型或另选模型生成，点击卡片才发送。单独生成会读取该轮对话并消耗模型额度，卡片保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Automatically manages dsh session titles in a date｜type｜topic format, with a model summarizing the type and topic of the whole conversation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 由模型概括会话主题，按“日期｜类型｜主题”格式自动命名。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Makes DSH speak when a job finishes: automatic voice alerts for done, failed and approval events, 20 built-in sounds with zero config, or clone your own voice.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在任务完成、失败或等待审批时语音提醒，提供内置音效，也可使用自己的音色。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Install a pinned rea-agents release locally, start its MCP service and upgrade through an update control.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 在本地安装指定版本的 rea-agents、启动其 MCP 服务，并通过更新入口升级。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Call or text your phone from a DSH run using the hosted /call-me service; the phone app requires a paid subscription after its trial.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 通过托管的 /call-me 服务在 DSH 运行时拨打电话或发送文字；手机应用试用后需要付费订阅。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Rewrite matching system, developer and assistant prompt fragments for the WorkBuddy China gateway to work around error 11128. Wraps global fetch; requires Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 针对 WorkBuddy 国内网关 11128 错误改写 system、developer 和 assistant 消息中的指定片段；会包装全局 fetch，需要 Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: ★ 9 │ OpenCode on DeepSeek Harness: session affinity, Zen/Go gateway origin headers, free-tier tool fallback, and live Go quota display.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 接入 OpenCode Zen/Go，保持会话与网关的对应关系，提供免费档工具调用回退和 Go 额度显示。

description.en: ★ 2 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: Claude Code-style prompt history with Up/Down navigation, a double-Esc history search picker, and selection quote/copy with right-click paste.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过上下键和双击 Esc 查找提示词历史，支持划选引用、复制和右键粘贴。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show supported providers’ balances, subscription limits and usage. Credentials are sent to the corresponding provider; OpenAI organization cost reporting requires a separate Admin Key.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 汇总支持的供应商余额、订阅额度与用量；查询时会向对应服务商发送凭据，OpenAI 组织费用统计需另配 Admin Key。

description.en: ★ 106 │ Apply a collection of persistent color themes to the web interface.
description.zh: ★ 106 │ 为网页界面应用多套可持久保存的主题配色。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Ollama bundle: configures the ollama provider for llm-pi-ai and sets web_search to use the Ollama backend, including provider selection in the web row, all in one go.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 配置 Ollama 模型供应商和网页搜索后端，可在网页中切换。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Tab suggestions for the next message and inline draft continuation. Makes background model calls over recent conversation and tool context, using the session model or a configured model and consuming tokens. Accepting inserts editable text without sending. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 为下一条消息和草稿续写提供 Tab 候选，后台调用当前会话模型或指定模型，读取近期对话与工具上下文并消耗 token；采纳仅写入草稿，不自动发送。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Display ModelScope balance and request statistics, with optional registration of ModelScope models as a provider.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 显示魔搭余额和调用统计，并可选择将魔搭模型注册为模型提供方。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Collects pinned sessions from every workspace visible in DSH's native view into one sidebar section, reusing the native rows, status and actions; follows native collapse and search, with a separate or shared scroll area. Client-only. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.19.0.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 把 DSH 原生视图中各工作区的置顶会话集中显示在侧栏，复用原有会话行、状态与操作；范围随原生折叠和搜索变化，可选独立滚动或随工作区列表滚动。纯前端插件。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22.19.0。

description.en: Zoom, browse, download, and annotate image regions in the DSH conversation viewer.
description.zh: 为会话图片提供缩放、多图浏览、原图下载和区域标注。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Back up and restore dsh-mnemon memory spaces, project documents and runtime memory to S3-compatible storage or WebDAV, with scheduled backups and per-file SHA-256 checks. Restores preview first and only write inside the selected component. Requires dsh-mnemon and your own storage credentials; DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把 dsh-mnemon 的记忆空间、项目档案与运行时记忆备份到 S3 兼容存储或 WebDAV，支持定时备份和逐文件 SHA-256 校验。恢复先预览，且只写入所选组件目录。需配合 dsh-mnemon 和自备存储凭据；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 211 │ Expose REA reverse-engineering tools through MCP. Uses the Harness runtime with a prepared REA 6.4.0 install, or falls back to npx requiring network and npx on PATH. Native tools need separate setup; optional WSL support starts disabled.
description.zh: ★ 211 │ 通过 MCP 接入 REA 逆向工具。优先用宿主运行时启动已准备的 REA 6.4.0，否则回退到 npx，需要网络和可用的 npx。原生工具需另行准备，WSL 扩展默认关闭。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Expose Xcode project, simulator, build, install, launch, screenshot and log operations as native agent tools.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 把 Xcode 工程、模拟器、构建、安装、运行、截图和日志操作接为原生 Agent 工具。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Connect an installed Video Reader core to DSH for timestamped video text, frames, queues and optional Scroll account workflows. Windows only; requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1, a separately installed core and VIDEO_READER_ROOT. Private delivery and scheduling need separate configuration.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将已安装的 Video Reader 核心接入 DSH，读取带时间文字与画面，管理队列，并可使用 Scroll 账号工作流。仅 Windows；需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、另装核心并设置 VIDEO_READER_ROOT，私信与调度需单独配置。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show a breakdown of each conversation turn by model, coding, build, test and cleanup time. Runs locally without extra model calls.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在每轮对话中展示模型、编码、构建、测试和清理的耗时分类；本地统计，不额外调用模型。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Create, import and manage personality presets, with global and per-conversation choices. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 创建、导入和管理人格预设，支持全局与单会话选择。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: ★ 124 │ Read-only DSH session insights and local model usage statistics
description.zh: ★ 124 │ 只读查看会话运行信息与本机模型用量统计。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Tavily web search for DSH (keyless or keyed, official DeepSeek when off), plus the Tavily MCP: search, extract, crawl, map and research.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 接入 Tavily 网页搜索和 MCP 的提取、抓取、站点映射与研究工具；关闭后使用 DeepSeek 默认搜索。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Attach existing conversations as visible children, delegate tasks and return results within the tree. Child creation inherits the parent sandbox mode and approval policy. Requires Node >=24 and DSH 0.2.2-rc.3; summaries and delegated work use the selected model and can incur charges. Session recycling uses the Windows Recycle Bin.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将已有会话挂载为可见子会话，在树内派发任务并返回结果；新子会话继承父会话的沙箱模式和审批策略。需 Node >=24 与 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3，摘要和派发任务使用所选模型并可能产生费用；会话回收使用 Windows 回收站。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage SSH hosts, SFTP and terminal sessions, with encrypted saved passwords. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 管理 SSH 主机、SFTP 和终端会话，可加密保存密码。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0。

description.en: Store project knowledge in editable Markdown files shared across sessions in the same project.
description.zh: 将项目知识保存为可编辑的 Markdown 文件，供同一项目的多个会话共享。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Close right sidebar tabs with middle-click or double-click. Depends on the host dock tab attributes.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过鼠标中键或双击关闭右侧栏标签，依赖宿主 dock 标签属性。

description.en: ★ 1 │ View and edit project and global AGENTS.md-style rule files for DSH and other AI tools, with Markdown preview and version-safe writes. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5; changes are written to the selected rule files.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 查看和编辑 DSH 及其他 AI 工具的项目级、全局规则文件，支持 Markdown 预览和版本校验写入。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5，保存时会修改选中的规则文件。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Preview and move selected session workspace files to a local trash when deleting a session; files can be restored. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0 and Node >=20.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 删除会话时预览并将选中的工作区文件移入本地回收站，支持恢复。需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0、Node >=20。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Search CNKI, organize a literature library and prepare reading, research and writing plans. Live CNKI search needs dsh-browser-cdp and local Edge; falls back to the host web search when unavailable. Can read selected local documents and save reports. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 检索知网、整理文献库，并生成精读、选题与分步写作计划。真实知网检索需另装 dsh-browser-cdp 和本机 Edge，不可用时回退宿主网页搜索；可读取指定本地文档并保存报告。需要 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Save reusable prompts and shell commands globally or per workspace, then run them from session controls.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 按全局或工作区保存提示词与 Shell 命令，再从会话中执行。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Play a random bundled sound after each Agent turn in the Web UI. Audio starts after a page gesture; bundled audio and meme images come from third parties. No DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 每轮 Agent 回合结束后，在 Web 界面随机播放内置音效；需先与页面交互解锁音频。附带音频和表情图来自第三方，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 86 │ Inspect injection patterns, redaction rules and local configuration, and produce risk reports.
description.zh: ★ 86 │ 检查提示注入模式、脱敏规则与本机配置，并输出风险报告。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Manage manual and automatic model or mechanical context compaction, with fallback models. Requires Node >=24 and the host compaction-basic plugin.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 管理手动和自动的模型或机械上下文压缩，支持备用模型；需要 Node >=24，并保留宿主 compaction-basic 插件。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read and search RSS/Atom locally, import OPML, capture pages and request summaries or a native reading companion through DSH models. Requires Node >=22.19.0 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or 0.2.2-rc.1, with native better-sqlite3; only macOS/0.2.1-rc.5 is author-tested. Feeds and remote images contact source sites; model use may incur fees.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 本地阅读和全文搜索 RSS/Atom，支持 OPML、网页摘录、手动总结和原生伴读。需 Node >=22.19.0、DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或 0.2.2-rc.1 及原生 better-sqlite3；作者仅验证 macOS/0.2.1-rc.5。订阅和远程图片会访问来源站点，模型使用可能产生费用。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect decision providers through one interface: Jev via TypeSafe, Clef via Cloudflare, Drex via Nace, Decider via meraGPT, self-hosted Laya and custom providers. Return structured classifications, scores, selections and image locations; supported media depend on the provider and model.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 统一接入 TypeSafe 的 Jev、Cloudflare 的 Clef、Nace 的 Drex、meraGPT 的 Decider、自建 Laya 与自定义提供方，返回分类、评分、筛选及图片定位等结构化结果；媒体支持取决于提供方和模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Prepare Chinese daily or weekly reports from your PRs, Git commits and local Claude Code, Codex or DSH sessions. Requires Python 3.11+, Git, zstd for DSH sessions and an authenticated gh CLI for GitHub evidence. Collected session excerpts are stored locally and may be supplied to the writing model; inspect the report before sharing.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 根据本人 PR、Git 提交及本地 Claude Code、Codex 或 DSH 会话整理中文日报周报。需 Python 3.11+、Git，读取 DSH 会话还需 zstd，查询 GitHub 证据需已登录 gh；会话摘录保存在本机并可能交给写作模型，分享前需检查报告内容。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Update registry-installed plugin bundles through the host plugin manager. Enabled for all eligible packages by default; checks every six hours and updates up to five packages per run. Requires a restart to load the host half.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过宿主插件管理器更新注册表安装的插件。默认对所有符合条件的包启用，每 6 小时检查，每轮最多更新 5 个；宿主部分需重启后加载。

description.en: ★ 49 │ Context retrieval for DeepSeek Harness: ranks docs, code and media by relevance into a sidebar Context Pack. Lexical and fully local by default. Hybrid is off until you configure a provider; it sends your query and file titles/summaries, not bodies.
description.zh: ★ 49 │ 按当前任务检索文档、代码与媒体，在侧栏整理相关资料；默认本地运行，混合检索需另行配置。

description.en: ★ 14 │ Add a generate_image tool backed by FAL, any OpenAI-compatible image API or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, with results shown inline and optional approval and budget limits.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 提供 generate_image 工具，可接 FAL、OpenAI 兼容的图像接口或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，图片直接显示在对话中，可设置审批和预算上限。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Browse Windows volumes and documents with per-folder size scans and a treemap, quote selected paths into chat, create folders and move items to Recycle Bin after confirmation. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 and Windows PowerShell 5.1.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 浏览 Windows 卷和文档，按目录统计大小、查看矩形树图并引用路径到对话；支持新建目录和确认后移入回收站。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5、Windows PowerShell 5.1。

title.zh: 归档回收站与存储概览

description.en: ★ 0 │ Move archived conversations and dedicated subagents to recoverable trash, restore or permanently delete selected logs, and inspect storage usage. For macOS/Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 or 0.2.1-rc.5 with JSONL storage and Node >=24. Permanent deletion cannot be undone; shared attachments and project files remain.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将归档会话与专属子代理移入回收站，按需恢复或永久清除，并查看存储占用。适用于 macOS/Windows 的 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3、0.2.1-rc.5，需 JSONL 存储和 Node >=24。永久清除不可撤销，保留共享附件和项目文件。

title.zh: DSH Markup · 对话批注与文档审阅

description.en: ★ 1 │ Annotate model replies, review documents and bring summaries back to a conversation. Previously dsh-doc-review; remove the old package before installing. Records stay in browser localStorage; model-assisted review uses tokens. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 批注模型回复、审阅文档并将摘要带回对话。原名 dsh-doc-review，安装前请先卸载旧包；记录保存在浏览器本地，模型辅助审阅消耗 token。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3。

plugins.name: @yiqizhuang/zhuangzai-dsh-workbench
plugins.author: 一起装 · 丁满信息科技（上海）有限公司

description.en: ★ 0 │ A Yiqizhuang workbench, agent preset and scenario Skills for construction delivery, staffing, issues, schedules, acceptance, equipment and reports. Requires a configured DSH model, your own Yiqizhuang account and company data permissions, plus manual OAuth setup. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 结合一起装 MCP、角色预设与场景技能，分析工地交付、人员派工、问题、工期、验收、设备和报告。需已配置模型的 DSH、自己的“一起装”账号与公司数据权限，并手动完成 OAuth 授权。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 257 │ Summon any of 331 domain experts or five built-in expert teams in DSH for reviews, design, operations and research, with the main session pulling the results together.
description.zh: ★ 257 │ 在 DSH 中召唤 331 位专业智能体或 5 个内置专家团，协助代码审查、设计、运营和研究，由主会话汇总结果。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Hand tasks from Codex to explicitly registered DSH workspaces and return results through scoped pairing. Uses a pinned Git release; requires Windows, Node >=22, Python >=3.11 and manual workspace pairing. Default /codex-bridge conflicts with codex-dsh-collab.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将 Codex 任务交给明确登记的 DSH 工作区，通过限定范围的配对接收结果。使用固定 Git 版本，需 Windows、Node >=22、Python >=3.11 并手动登记配对；默认 /codex-bridge 路由与 codex-dsh-collab 冲突。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Long-term memory as editable markdown cards with SQLite FTS5 and optional local Chinese embeddings, injected each turn when relevant and managed from a settings page. Optional embedding models download from a Hugging Face mirror. Requires DSH ^0.2.1-rc.2 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 以可读可改的 markdown 卡片保存长期记忆，配合 SQLite FTS5 与可选本地中文向量，每轮按相关性注入，并可在设置页管理。可选向量模型从 Hugging Face 镜像下载。需 DSH ^0.2.1-rc.2、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: ★ 2 │ DSH plugin: one uniform frosted-glass material for the UI surfaces, plus an optional image or video dynamic wallpaper behind them.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 为界面应用统一磨砂玻璃效果，可搭配图片或视频壁纸。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Turns DSH's settings dialog into a Codex-style full-page fullscreen settings page for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 将设置弹窗改为 Codex 风格的全屏设置页。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Edit and search notes, tasks and documents, with tables, attachments, export and agent collaboration.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 编辑和搜索笔记、待办与文档，支持表格、附件、导出和 Agent 协作。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read Xiaohongshu recommendations, Baidu Tieba threads and NGA forums in the workspace, with quoted replies to NGA. Declares DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1; author tested Windows 0.2.2-rc.1. Xiaohongshu needs Chrome or Edge on the host; login and site restrictions apply. Clicking the NGA reply button publishes to the forum.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在工作区阅读小红书推荐、百度贴吧和 NGA，并引用楼层回帖。声明兼容 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1，作者实测 Windows 0.2.2-rc.1。小红书需宿主安装 Chrome 或 Edge，登录及访问受站点限制；点击 NGA 回帖按钮会公开发布。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Deploy ten skills for long-form manuscript checks, revision proposals and verification. Loading the plugin installs skill files locally; existing edits are kept unless overwrite is explicitly requested.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 部署十个长篇文稿校验技能，按检查、修改建议、人工选择及复核组织工作。加载插件会在本机安装技能文件，只有明确要求覆盖时才替换已有修改。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Stop automatic following once a generated answer fills the visible conversation area, keeping its opening in view. Works with or without dsh-smooth-stream and depends on the host conversation DOM.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 生成的回答铺满会话可视区域后停止自动跟随，保留开头供阅读。可独立使用或搭配 dsh-smooth-stream，依赖宿主会话 DOM 标记。

description.en: ★ 6,418 │ Build local data dashboards with source inspection. Requires dsh-claude-artifacts; supply data and any external service access.
description.zh: ★ 6,418 │ 制作可查看数据来源的本地看板；需 dsh-claude-artifacts，数据及外部服务访问需自行提供。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Schedule one-off, interval, daily, weekly, cron or webhook tasks in DSH, delivering messages to new or existing sessions with run history.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH 中创建一次性、间隔、每天、每周、Cron 或 Webhook 任务，向新建或已有会话投递消息，并查看运行记录。

description.en: ★ 4 │ View a session’s plugins and skills from its header, and enable or disable installed bundles and configured MCP servers in the current profile. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在会话标题栏查看当前会话的插件和技能，并启停当前 profile 中的插件包与 MCP 服务。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage interface and code fonts, sizes, weights, three-color themes and named appearance presets in Settings. Uses fonts available on the client; verified by the author on Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在外观设置统一管理界面与代码字体、字号、字重、三色主题和命名外观方案。使用客户端已有字体；作者实测 Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A paper and ink science-fiction theme for the DSH conversation interface. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 对话界面提供米白与墨黑科幻风格；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Open temporary side conversations and return draft conclusions to the main chat. Replaces the host persistence and query components with adapters; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and Node >=22.19.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 打开临时侧聊并向主线回传结论草稿。会以适配器替换宿主会话存储和查询组件；需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3、Node >=22.19。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Local long-term memory with automatic extraction and semantic recall. Requires Node.js 24; downloads a local embedding model and uses the configured model for extraction and review.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 本地长期记忆，支持自动提炼和语义召回。需要 Node.js 24；会下载本地向量模型，并使用已配置的模型提炼和复核。

description.en: ★ 67 │ Collapse the idle composer and automatically close the sidebar on narrow screens.
description.zh: ★ 67 │ 收起闲置输入框，并在窄屏选中会话后自动关闭侧栏。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Search Google Scholar, citing papers and all versions through SerpAPI with three agent tools sharing one monthly quota. Requires your own SerpAPI key; queries are sent to serpapi.com. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过 SerpAPI 检索 Google Scholar、被引文献和全部版本，三个 Agent 工具共享月度配额。需自备 SerpAPI Key，检索词会发送到 serpapi.com。未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Keep a persistent PTY Bash terminal per DSH session, attach across agents by session id and run commands as asynchronous jobs. Requires Bash and a PTY subprocess provider; commands use the host user's permissions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为每个 DSH 会话保留持久 PTY Bash 终端，按会话 ID 跨 Agent 连接，并以异步作业运行命令。需要 Bash 与支持 PTY 的子进程服务，命令以宿主用户权限执行。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky secondary-development plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): typed tools over the Kingdee Cloud WebAPI, credential-safe config, and a companion domain skill.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过金蝶云 WebAPI 进行云星空二次开发，提供配套工具、凭据配置和领域技能。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Notify for approvals, questions and completed sessions with interactive cards, a desktop pet and browser wake recovery.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在审批、提问和会话完成时提醒，提供操作卡片、桌面宠物和浏览器唤醒重连。

description.en: ★ 21 │ A library for patching, replacing and decorating DeepSeek Harness plugins during runtime
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 在 DSH 运行时修改、替换或扩展插件行为。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Provides the current Web instance's tokenized access URL to the model and shell via DSH_WEB_AUTH_URL, resolved on each shell call, plus a cookie-jar usage note. Secrets stay out of prompts and transcripts.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 DSH_WEB_AUTH_URL 向 Shell 提供当前网页实例的认证地址，在执行时解析令牌，避免写入提示词和会话记录。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Customize DSH colors, saved presets and contrast hints, with optional glass panels, wallpaper or generated backgrounds. The package does not declare a DSH compatibility range.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 调整 DSH 界面与正文配色、保存方案并查看对比度提示，可选玻璃面板、壁纸或生成背景。包内未声明适用的 DSH 版本。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Review dependency advisories and static behavior evidence; automatic disabling requires a reviewed malicious finding.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 检查依赖漏洞和插件行为证据，只有审核确认恶意行为后才自动停用插件。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A local idle game in the DSH sidebar: earn game tokens, recruit models and progress through battles and vendor events. Saves in browser local storage; uses no model API.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ DSH 侧栏里的挂机经营小游戏，通过任务获取游戏 Token、招募模型并推进军团关卡和厂商事件。存档保存在浏览器本地，不调用模型 API。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Session-sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness: git-backed cross-machine session sync with its own web settings surface, row-menu action, and sync-records dialog
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过 Git 在多台机器间同步会话，在网页设置和会话菜单中管理同步记录。

description.en: ★ 43 │ Share one or several Q&A rounds as PNG images, Markdown or HTML, with adjustable width, font size and whether to show the process.
description.zh: ★ 43 │ 把单轮或多轮问答导出为 PNG 图片、Markdown 或 HTML 分享，可调整宽度、字号以及是否显示过程。

title.zh: 玄枢 · 中华传统智慧

description.en: ★ 65 │ A local-first consultation skill on traditional Chinese culture, with BaZi, Zi Wei, Liu Yao, feng shui and more computed by a local engine. For cultural reference, not prediction.
description.zh: ★ 65 │ 本地优先的中国传统文化咨询技能，八字、紫微、六爻、风水等由本地引擎计算，分层给出事实、文化解释和现实建议。仅供传统文化参考，不作预测。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Use a SuperGrok or X Premium Grok Build subscription in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 的 Grok Build 订阅。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Quote selected message text into the composer with source roles and preserved code fences, then jump back from quote chips or sent cards. Selections must stay within one message.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 划选消息文字并引用到输入框，保留来源角色与代码围栏，可从引用标签或发送后的卡片跳回原文。选区须位于同一条消息内。

description.en: ★ 58 │ Delivery quality gate for DeepSeek Harness: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery, and gate the handoff with a deliverable/rework decision.
description.zh: ★ 58 │ 通过需求澄清、实现检查与交付证据决定交付或返工。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Federated plugin discovery and update UI for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x, integrated with the native Plugin Manager.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 汇总多个来源的插件，提供发现和更新界面，并与 DSH 原生插件管理器集成。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Password gate: when DSH opens, a password screen appears first, and the app is usable only after unlocking. Supports manual and automatic locking, with passwords stored as one-way scrypt hashes.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 添加密码锁屏，支持手动与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 哈希保存。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Operate an Android emulator in a native DSH sidebar, with configurable APK, package, activity and monorepo paths. Flutter debug APKs hot-reload on Dart save; plain APKs can turn Flutter off. Requires an existing APK, a running emulator, the Android SDK and scrcpy 3.3.3; verified on a Windows emulator.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH 原生侧栏中操作 Android 模拟器，可配置 APK、包名、Activity 与 monorepo 源码目录。Flutter 调试包保存 Dart 文件即热重载，普通 APK 可关闭 Flutter 模式。需已有 APK、运行中的模拟器、Android SDK 与 scrcpy 3.3.3，已在 Windows 模拟器上验证。

title.zh: Task Guard Badge（工具状态面板）

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show tool narrowing and activity with manual group and mode controls. Needs Minimal Router; routes currently lack authentication, so use only in a trusted local environment. Does not replace host permissions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 显示工具收窄状态和活动，支持手动选组、切换模式，需搭配 Minimal Router。接口目前无认证，仅建议在可信本机环境使用，不替代宿主权限。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Connect local folders, S3-compatible storage, WebDAV and Yandex Disk, with encrypted section-based backups, a portable backup of the core configuration and your own executable backup scripts. Note: the storage_write tool can upload any local file to a configured storage without an approval prompt.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 接入本地目录、S3 兼容存储、WebDAV 和 Yandex Disk，支持按分区加密备份、可迁移的核心配置备份，以及自己编写的可执行备份脚本。注意：storage_write 工具可以不经审批把本机任意文件上传到已配置的存储。

description.en: Assess tool-call risks through StartLux. Requires a Bamboo Relay API Key and sends tool arguments and recent context to the configured service. Disabled by default; shadow mode records decisions, and errors allow the call through.
description.zh: 通过 StartLux 评估工具调用风险，需 Bamboo Relay API Key，并向配置的服务发送工具参数和近期上下文。默认关闭；观察模式只记录判断，异常时放行。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Twelve character presets with WebP icons for DSH Web profiles, including finance, market research, strategy planning and cross-border e-commerce roles. Declares DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 only.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH Web profile 提供 12 个带 WebP 图标的角色预设，包括金融、市场研究、策略规划和跨境电商等角色。仅声明 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect playwright-mcp and peekaboo-mcp for browser and desktop control, with dependency setup and connection diagnostics.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 接入 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp 操控浏览器和桌面，提供依赖安装与连接诊断。

description.en: ★ 1,015 │ Composable memory with pluggable sources and strategies for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 1,015 │ 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可组合记忆、可插拔来源与记忆策略。

description.en: ★ 0 │ The core Japanese locale pack for the DSH Web GUI. It registers Japanese and provides ja dictionaries for every DSH core plugin namespace, independent of dsh-i18n-ja, with English fallback for missing keys.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 核心界面提供独立日语语言包，缺少翻译时显示英文。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Adjust the client scrollbar width from the plugin settings, from 4 to 20 pixels.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在插件设置中统一调整客户端滚动条宽度，支持 4–20 像素。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Set image input and reasoning levels for third-party provider models.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为第三方模型设置图片输入能力和推理强度。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Inspect local session logs for lost constraints, hallucinated summaries and pruning issues. Requires zstd; results are deterministic heuristics.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 读取本机会话日志，检查约束遗漏、摘要幻觉与裁剪问题。需安装 zstd，结果为确定性规则估算。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Record a browser bug, lock the expected result and compare candidate fixes against the original code. Runs local development commands and stores evidence in the project .buggps directory; Git worktrees are not a sandbox. For DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 headless/web; needs Git, pnpm >=10 and Chrome or Edge.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 录制浏览器问题、固定预期，再将候选修复与原代码对照验证。会运行本地开发命令，并在项目 .buggps 目录保存证据；Git worktree 不提供沙箱隔离。适用于 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 的 headless/web，需 Git、pnpm >=10、Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在模型设置中调整第三方模型的推理强度，提供 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM 和 MiMo 预设。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Recall locally saved composer prompts and attachments with Arrow Up and Arrow Down when the composer is empty. Keeps up to 50 submissions in browser storage.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 输入框为空时，用上下方向键恢复历史提示词和附件；最多在浏览器本地保存 50 条提交记录。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Ledger for the DSH right sidebar: log entries (amount, category, note), view monthly totals and category stats; data stays local, and the agent can read and write via ledger_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏记账，按月和分类查看收支，数据保存在本机，Agent 也可读写记录。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Store project pitfalls and reusable practices in separate volumes, with monotonic identifiers and synchronized indexes.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 分册保存项目常见问题和可复用做法，用递增编号管理条目并同步索引。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness turn ends: bundled Python/PowerShell notifier, custom command fallback, and its own Settings page.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话轮次结束时发送桌面通知，提供 Python/PowerShell 通知器，也可执行自定义通知命令。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Run a task in a fresh, isolated DSH runtime (dsh --profile headless) with its own DSH_HOME, session and model routing, and return only the final answer to the parent session through the subagent_dsh tool. Note: the startup handshake timeout does not take effect yet, so a child that never becomes ready can keep the call waiting.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把任务交给全新、隔离的 DSH 运行时（dsh --profile headless）执行，独立 DSH_HOME、会话与模型路由，只通过 subagent_dsh 工具把最终回答带回父会话。注意：启动握手超时目前不生效，子运行时未就绪时调用可能一直等待。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Manage DSH_HOME/.env in Settings, update the running host environment and synchronize Windows/macOS user variables. Compare and install the dsh CLI launcher on PATH. Uses native koffi, which may require build approval; declares DSH >=0.2.0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在设置中管理 DSH_HOME/.env，热更新 Host 环境并同步 Windows/macOS 用户变量，可检查和安装 PATH 上的 dsh CLI。会修改当前用户环境；原生依赖 koffi 可能需允许构建，声明适配 DSH >=0.2.0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Save a message, turn or conversation to Obsidian, SiYuan, Joplin, Notion, Yuque or ima after preview. Configure each destination and its credentials; requires host Connection authentication. Same-title Obsidian notes use exclusive create with retry.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 预览后将单条消息、一轮或整个会话存入 Obsidian、思源、Joplin、Notion、语雀或 ima；需配置目标和凭据，并使用提供 Connection 认证的宿主。同名 Obsidian 笔记改为独占创建并重试。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Media models: standalone image and video model configuration, plus chat generation tools.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 独立配置图片和视频模型，并在会话中调用生成工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Patch three Subscriptions files on startup to separate reasoning, text and tool-call channels. Checked against 0.7.55; shared OpenAI-chat providers are affected. Backups and CLI restore are available; fully restart after patching, and uninstall does not restore files. Requires Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 启动时修改 Subscriptions 三个文件，分离思考、正文与工具调用；已核对 0.7.55，也影响共享 OpenAI-chat 路径的其他提供商。带备份及 CLI 回滚，补丁后需完整重启，卸载不会恢复文件；需要 Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: inventory your Windows dev/test toolchain, spot the gaps, and fill them with one click.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 检查 Windows 开发和测试工具链，找出并补齐缺失组件。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Open a temporary conversation in the right sidebar, using the main conversation text as model context. Tabs are archived when closed or after a restart; the added context can increase model usage.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在右侧栏打开临时对话，将主对话文本作为模型上下文；关闭标签页或重启后归档，额外上下文可能增加模型消耗。

description.en: ★ 26 │ Command Code Go provider adapter for dsh: scan the Go-plan model catalog dynamically and serve /alpha/generate through the harness LLM seam
description.zh: ★ 26 │ 接入 Command Code Go 套餐，自动读取可用模型并在 DSH 中调用。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage Doubao and WeType word lists with detection, TSV exports, backups, terminology search and staged imports. Requires python3 on PATH; platform-specific input-method paths apply. Applying changes to the live input method remains a manual step, and optional terminology search uses the network.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 管理豆包和微信输入法词库，支持检测、TSV 导出、备份、术语搜索及暂存导入。需 PATH 中有 python3，输入法路径随平台而异；正式应用到输入法仍需手动操作，可选术语搜索会联网。

title.zh: DSH 插件减负与兼容性体检

description.en: ★ 0 │ Inspect plugin inventory and compatibility, prepare a trim draft and apply bounded enable/disable changes with snapshots and rollback. Changes affect the current profile; review the draft before applying. Requires Node >=20 and DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 检查插件清单与兼容性，生成减负草稿，并对受限的启停项保存快照、执行和回滚。变更影响当前 profile，应用前需核对草稿。需 Node >=20 和 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A small easter egg when a task finishes, an optional desktop pet, and local water, meal and rest reminders. Works only inside the open web page; sends no system notifications or model requests.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 任务完成时的小彩蛋，可选常驻桌宠，以及本地喝水、吃饭、休息提醒。只在打开的网页里工作，不发系统通知，也不发模型请求。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Play Gomoku against local AI, an arcade sky shooter and Chubby Fish Adventure in the DSH Web sidebar, with sound controls and local scores. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH Web 侧栏玩人机五子棋、飞机大战和肥鱼大冒险，支持音效开关及本机战绩。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show cumulative tokens across local DSH sessions in the header and keep a local ledger after session deletion. Requires Host connection authentication; long uninterrupted event bursts can affect live counting.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在顶栏显示本机 DSH 会话累计 Token，删会话后保留本地账本。需要宿主连接认证；长时间连续事件可能影响实时计数。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Group subagents by usage batch, delete individual agents or groups with confirmation, and select models from the current catalog. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 or later.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 按使用批次分组子代理，支持二次确认后单个或整组删除，并从实时目录选择模型。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 或更高版本。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Add Pi, Pi+ and Pi-IM agent modes with a trimmed tool set and Chinese system prompts; Pi+ enables the official apply_patch tool. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=24.9.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 新增 Pi、Pi+ 与 Pi-IM 三种 Agent 模式，精简工具并使用中文系统提示词；Pi+ 开启官方 apply_patch。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=24.9。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Split a local video into selectable reference frames and export a contact sheet, CSV and JSON. Requires separately installed ffmpeg/ffprobe 5.1+ and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把本地视频切为可勾选的参考帧，导出联系表、CSV 和 JSON。需另装 ffmpeg/ffprobe 5.1+，以及 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Sets default models for DSH subagents, with sequential or random assignment across models and cross-vendor failover on connection errors. Shows the current vendor and model in trajectory and conversation views.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 为子 Agent 分配默认模型，支持顺序或随机选择，以及连接失败时切换供应商。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation header, with model-planned commit groups.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在会话标题栏提交工作区改动，由模型规划提交分组。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Combine PTC coding mode, Cordis tools and preset-authoring skills in switchable agent presets.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 把 PTC 编码模式、Cordis 工具和预设编写技能组合为可切换的 Agent 预设。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Replace SurfCore 0.8.8 memory-card decay with configurable score lifetimes and daily, long-term and permanent tiers. A companion patcher for the installed desktop-profile SurfCore, with verification, backup and rollback; changes local SurfCore files and requires a restart.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 SurfCore 0.8.8 的记忆卡替换可调节的分数寿命与日常、长期、永久档位。它是 desktop profile 已安装 SurfCore 的配套补丁，校验后备份、应用并可回滚，会修改本机 SurfCore 文件，需重启。

description.en: ★ 10,458 │ Gather the switches and settings of the dsh-web plugin family into one section of the DSH settings page.
description.zh: ★ 10,458 │ 把 dsh-web 系列插件的开关和配置表单集中到 DSH 设置页的一个分区里。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Organize the native sidebar into Pinned, Inbox, Working and Archived sections without replacing session rows. Requires the Web UI and Node >=24.9.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将原生侧栏按置顶、收件箱、进行中和归档分区，保留原生会话行与操作。需 Web 界面和 Node >=24.9。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Add a Continue button below the composer and resume turns cut off by a network drop, an output limit or a host restart, through DSH’s own submission path; real refusals such as quota or permission are reported, not retried. Note: its local API checks Host/Origin but does not yet use DSH host authentication.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在输入框下方加「继续」按钮，回合因断网、输出上限或宿主重启中断时，通过 DSH 自身的提交链路自动续跑；额度、权限等真实拒绝如实报告，不反复重试。注意：本机接口目前只检查 Host/Origin，尚未接入 DSH 宿主认证。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Browse Douyin in a dedicated Google Chrome window on macOS, send sampled frames to a configured vision model and update interests from real watch progress. Optional automation can reply to approved friends and groups, share videos and post public comments (off by default) from your account; check Douyin’s rules before enabling it.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 macOS 专用 Google Chrome 窗口里刷抖音，把画面采样交给已配置的图片模型，按真实观看进度更新兴趣。可选的自动化会用你的账号回复许可好友和群聊、分享作品和发公开评论（默认关闭），开启前请留意抖音平台规则。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Show the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer and configure it from the plugin page.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页配置显示方式。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Manage forge accounts and project authorization, then supply HTTPS credentials through a helper and reject unauthorized hosts.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 管理代码托管账号和项目授权，通过凭据助手提供 HTTPS 认证，并拒绝未授权主机。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Use WorkBuddy CN or global accounts as DSH model providers with account pools, usage and manual probes. Optional image/video and read-only CodeBuddy review tools require separate activation and host approval per call; they may consume account credit. Keep account credentials local and protect owner access.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 将 WorkBuddy 国内或国际账号接为 DSH 模型供应商，支持账号池、用量和手动探测。可选图像、视频与 CodeBuddy 只读复核工具需另行启用并逐次通过宿主审批，可能消耗账号额度；请保护本机凭据和所有者访问。

description.en: ★ 28 │ A real PowerPoint, not HTML. Editable .pptx decks for AI agents, rendered on your own machine.
description.zh: ★ 28 │ 在本机生成、渲染可继续编辑的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

description.en: ★ 356 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin for Android — build, run, and interact with a live emulator or USB device stream inside a conversation, driven entirely through adb. Tested with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 356 │ 通过 adb 在会话中构建、运行并操作模拟器或 USB 设备。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Capture, OCR and control Windows background windows through a bundled Rust engine. Windows x64 only; declares DSH ^0.2.0-rc.2 and Node.js ^22.19 or >=24. Grants screen capture, mouse and keyboard capabilities.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过随包 Rust 引擎截取、识别和操控 Windows 后台窗口，提供鼠标与键盘工具。仅限 Windows x64，声明适配 DSH ^0.2.0-rc.2，需 Node.js ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Fullscreen lightbox for chat images with zoom, pan, download and paging, a thumbnail grid with adjustable columns, TIFF/HEIC transcoding, and an image-delivery rule.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 全屏查看会话图片，支持缩放、拖动、下载、翻页及缩略图网格，并转换 TIFF/HEIC 图片。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Provide native Cohere v2 language models, embeddings and reranking, including streamed tool calls and model discovery. Requires the @dsh-ai-providers/runtime bundle to be installed and activated, with separately configured connections and credentials.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 提供原生 Cohere v2 语言模型、嵌入与重排序，支持流式工具调用和模型发现。需要先安装并启用 @dsh-ai-providers/runtime 组合包，并另行配置连接与凭据。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Automatically discovers models on the Aperture gateway and adds them to DSH's model picker.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，并加入 DSH 的模型选择器。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Display a companion for each active conversation, with work-state animations, model colors and shared care. Download is about 184 MB. Native desktop companions require Windows DSH Desktop. Host routes use local Host/Origin or paired-device checks rather than Connection authentication; use in a trusted environment.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为每个活跃会话显示一只宠物，用动作和配色区分工作状态与模型，共享喂食、好感度和命名。下载约 184 MB，原生桌宠需 Windows DSH 桌面版；宿主接口采用本机 Host/Origin 或设备配对检查，仅建议在可信环境使用。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Summarize running, approval, completion and scheduled-task states on collapsed sidebar groups, with counts and hover details.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在收起的侧栏分组上汇总运行、审批、完成和定时任务状态，显示数量与悬停明细。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Save reference images with tags, notes and pinned style guides. The board is shared under DSH_HOME; the agent tool returns selected references to the model before UI work. Uploads use local DSH attachments. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 保存参考图、标签、备注与置顶风格指南，通过工具把选定参考交给模型用于界面设计。图板在 DSH_HOME 下共享，图片由 DSH 附件服务本地存储。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Collapses rarely used plugins' tool docs into a brief plus tool names, which the model can unwrap per plugin when needed (off by default; calls still follow host permissions). Also adds an editor for system, pinned-user and user-state prompts; full prompt composition needs the bundled host-support adapter applied by hand. For DSH PTC sessions. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 把不常用插件的工具说明折叠为简介和工具名，需要时由模型按插件整体展开（默认关闭，调用仍遵循宿主权限）。另提供系统、用户固定、用户状态三类提示词编排界面；完整编排需手动接入随包的 host-support 适配层。适用于 DSH PTC 会话。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Quality-first topic memory for DSH. Each topic keeps its starting question, conclusion, impact, and dependencies, not the process, in a local, git-traced OKF bundle with budgeted, LLM-free injection.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 按主题保存问题、结论、影响和依赖，用本地 Git 跟踪版本，并在预算范围内注入相关记忆。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Let the agent search the host model catalog and switch the current conversation to a selected model; switching also updates the default model.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 让 Agent 查询宿主模型目录并切换当前会话的模型；切换也会更新默认模型。

description.en: ★ 51 │ Inspect assistant presence across workspaces and move assistants between workspaces.
description.zh: ★ 51 │ 查看各工作区助手是否在线，并通过拖拽调整助手所属工作区。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Apply a near-black Matrix palette, glass sidebar and composer panels, with styling scoped to the theme. Keeps dark mode while enabled. Requires the DSH theme client service from 0.2.1-rc.2 or later.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 提供近黑色 Matrix 配色、玻璃侧栏与输入面板，样式限定在主题作用域内，启用期间保持暗色模式。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或更高版本的主题服务。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Add multi-engine web search with parallel queries and fallback across Startpage, DuckDuckGo and other services. Search queries leave the host for those engines; optional engines can use configured API keys. Requires Node >=20.3.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过多引擎并发与回退接入 Startpage、DuckDuckGo 等网页搜索服务。查询会发送到相应引擎，可选引擎可使用已配置的 API Key。需要 Node >=20.3。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Block Git commands inside Jujutsu workspaces and suggest the corresponding jj commands.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在 Jujutsu 工作区中阻止 Git 命令，并提示对应的 jj 命令。

description.en: ★ 3 │ A Review tab and guarded git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: changes vs HEAD as a filterable file tree with per-file diffs, a commit graph, and stage/commit/branch actions.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 按文件查看改动和差异，浏览提交图，执行暂存、提交和分支操作。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Global Cloudflare Code Mode MCP bundle: after installation, all DSH sessions automatically get the docs/search/execute tools and the cfbridge skill, working with the project-local Wrangler CLI passthrough.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 为所有 DSH 会话接入 Cloudflare Code Mode MCP 的文档、搜索和执行工具，配合项目本地 Wrangler 使用。

description.en: ★ 73 │ Fusion for DeepSeek Harness: one model entry backed by a frontier Lead that reads, briefs and reviews, and a much cheaper Sidekick that writes the code.
description.zh: ★ 73 │ 由主模型阅读资料、规划和复核，让成本较低的副模型编写代码。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Ask an authenticated local AtomCode CLI for workspace-scoped advice or bounded code reviews with structured findings.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 调用本机已登录的 AtomCode，针对当前工作目录提供持续咨询和范围明确的代码评审。

description.en: ★ 36 │ Transcribe speech with local SenseVoice or optional services, with hotwords and text polishing.
description.zh: ★ 36 │ 使用本机 SenseVoice 或可选语音服务转录输入，支持热词与文字润色。

description.en: ★ 6,418 │ Create local animations. Requires dsh-claude-artifacts; voice synthesis needs a configured provider and may incur charges.
description.zh: ★ 6,418 │ 制作本地动画；需 dsh-claude-artifacts，配音需自行配置语音服务，可能收费。

description.en: ★ 139 │ Hand tasks to your local DSH from Feishu, Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat, QQ, Telegram, Discord or Slack, and get replies, answer questions and approve tools in the same chat.
description.zh: ★ 139 │ 通过飞书、Lark、钉钉、企业微信、微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord 或 Slack 把任务交给本机 DSH，并在同一聊天里接收回复、回答问题和审批工具。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Search Chinese journals and global literature, read details, download Chinese journal full text, check quota and verify references through a SmartLib gateway. Requires your own gateway URL, secret and registered emails; searches and downloads consume paid SmartLib quota. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过 SmartLib 网关检索中文期刊与全球文献、查看详情、下载中文期刊全文、查询配额并核查参考文献真实性。需自备网关地址、密钥和已注册邮箱，检索与下载会消耗付费 SmartLib 配额。未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Structured decision layer for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop: a dangerous-call gate, output self-check, tool narrowing and loop guard, backed by a pluggable adjudication model.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 Agent 执行过程中检查高风险调用、核对输出、限制工具范围，并检测重复循环。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Plugin for the A6API multi-model aggregator: native LLM provider registration, live account balance and price-change monitoring, token allowlist sync, merchant route probing, and a panoramic metrics card.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 接入 A6API 模型，查看余额和价格变化，同步密钥使用的模型范围，并检查线路。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Play 2048 from the sidebar while waiting for an agent, using arrow keys, WASD or touch gestures, with up to 30 undo steps. Board state and high scores stay in browser localStorage. Requires the web UI; author-tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Desktop.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 等待 Agent 时从侧栏打开 2048，支持方向键、WASD、触屏滑动和最多 30 步撤销。棋盘与最高分保存在浏览器 localStorage。需要 Web 界面，作者验证环境为 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 桌面版。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Lingxi (灵犀) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a desktop cat that reacts to the mood of the work, with five model tools (task, say, react, state, remember) over the pet bridge, plus settings.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 添加会随工作状态反应的灵犀桌面猫，可通过工具安排任务、说话、切换状态和保存记忆。

description.en: ★ 47 │ Search session history, recall cited content and organize conversation views.
description.zh: ★ 47 │ 全文检索历史会话、引用召回内容，并管理会话视图。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Inspect visible skills and their sources, read SKILL.md, manage invocation permissions, and create or soft-delete skills.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 查看当前会话可用技能与来源，阅读说明、管理权限，并创建或移入回收区。

description.en: ★ 39 │ LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over language servers, plus the editor action protocol (lsp.actions.*) that makes the plugin the IDE integration backend
description.zh: ★ 39 │ 通过语言服务器执行诊断、格式化、补全、符号查询和重命名。

description.en: ★ 14 │ Use DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 as an ACP agent in Paseo, with streaming, persistent sessions, model selection and approval controls. Requires Paseo.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 把 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 作为 ACP Agent 接入 Paseo，支持流式输出、会话持久化、模型选择和审批控制。需要 Paseo。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that runs recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 根据任务表定时派发 Agent 任务，每次在独立 DSH 会话中执行。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage HTTP and stdio MCP servers in DSH Web settings. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-alpha.2 <0.3.0; checking or enabling a configured stdio server runs its command. Default server list is empty.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH Web 设置中管理 HTTP 与 stdio MCP 服务。需 DSH >=0.2.2-alpha.2 <0.3.0；检查或启用已配置的 stdio 服务会执行对应命令，默认服务列表为空。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Navigate back and forward between sessions and plugin panels, with confirmation before refreshing a running session.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话与插件面板之间后退、前进，刷新运行中的会话前先确认。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show account quota, subscription type and daily statistics in the session header, with refresh and error notices.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话标题栏显示账号额度、订阅类型与今日统计，支持刷新和异常提示。

description.en: ★ 1,015 │ Cap how many characters Mnemon memory may add to each turn. An optional add-on for Mnemon strategies; a very small cap can hide memories.
description.zh: ★ 1,015 │ 限制 Mnemon 记忆每轮注入上下文的字符数，是 Mnemon 主策略的可选扩展。上限设得过小可能漏掉记忆。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Analyze local session context costs, repeated prompts, skill catalogs and tool schemas. Requires zstd; token counts are estimates.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 分析本机会话的上下文开销、重复提示、技能目录及工具 schema。需安装 zstd，token 数为估算。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Filter large composer model catalogs by provider and model family with two levels of tabs plus search. Small catalogs keep the flat selector; the /model command is unchanged.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框的大型模型目录中按提供商、模型系列两级标签和搜索筛选，小目录保留平铺选择器，不改变 /model 命令。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Manage ChatGPT OAuth authorization for Codex models from DSH settings, with credential status and renewal prompts. Requires a compatible ChatGPT subscription.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH 设置中管理 Codex 模型的 ChatGPT OAuth 授权，查看凭据状态并在失效时提示重新授权。需兼容的 ChatGPT 订阅。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Finance terminal for the DSH right sidebar: cross-asset quotes, a rotating globe, a risk-appetite gauge, plain-Chinese explanations and related news, with two-way chat with the agent via finance_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏查看多类资产行情、风险偏好指标、中文说明和资讯，并与 Agent 交流。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Centrally manages environment variables injected into the host, with allowlisted hot reload for plugins that read them only at startup (such as dsh-sql).
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 集中管理宿主环境变量，对允许的插件热重载，使其读取更新后的值。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Register an idle-aware restart of the DSH host with dsh_restart: it waits for agents (including subagents) to finish, ends the process after a quiet window, and can leave a one-shot note. Exit methods include systemd user unit, a configured shell command, SIGTERM or process.exit. The optional status route reports only counters. Requires Node >=22. Issue asked for 1.0.0; this review is of latest 1.5.0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用 dsh_restart 登记一次空闲感知的宿主重启：等待所有 Agent（含子代理）结束后，经过安静窗口再结束进程，并可留下一次性提醒。退出方式包括 systemd 用户单元、配置的 shell 命令、SIGTERM 或 process.exit。可选状态接口只返回计数。需 Node >=22。议题写的是 1.0.0，本轮审查的是目前最新的 1.5.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show the signed-in DeepSeek account balance under the composer, with recharge and bonus breakdowns and periodic refresh. Reads through the host account client without storing an API key.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框下方显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户的可用余额、充值与赠送余额分项，并定期刷新。通过宿主账户客户端读取，不保存 API Key。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Record WAV voice memos, waveform images and timestamped notes. Transcription needs a configured ASR provider or local command; verify the selected provider’s privacy and model-download behavior.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 录制 WAV、生成波形和带时间戳的笔记；需所配 ASR 或本地命令，处理位置与模型下载行为取决于识别配置。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Show two output speeds in the footer: decode speed after the first token, and in parentheses the whole-request speed including first-token latency. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 在底栏同时显示两种输出速度：首 token 之后的解码速度，括号内为含首字延迟的整段速度。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: ★ 10,458 │ LiangShen (梁神) agent preset and its composer lever for the dsh web GUI. The host declares the bundled preset to the agent-preset registry at activation, so it can be selected for new sessions.
description.zh: ★ 10,458 │ 提供梁神 Agent 预设及输入框切换入口，可在新会话中选用。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Long-term Memory: remember vocabulary, preferences, and recent activity per scope, consolidated by Dream.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 按作用范围保存词汇、偏好和近期活动，通过 Dream 整理长期记忆。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Manage services and routes through a web console, with Cloudflare tunnels and password login.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过网页控制台管理服务和路由，支持 Cloudflare 隧道与口令登录。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Inspect profile plugins and Skills, preview updates, save snapshots and restore supported versions or Skill files after confirmation. Plugin recovery does not restore configuration, the dependency tree or presets. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 查看当前 profile 的插件与技能、预览更新、保存快照，并在确认后恢复支持的版本或技能文件。插件恢复不还原配置、完整依赖树或预设。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Distill archived conversations into reusable skills, a fact ledger whose outdated entries retire, and topic clusters; ongoing sessions can be digested read-only, and memory self-checks only measure unless asked to rewrite. Note: its local API checks Host/Origin but does not yet use DSH host authentication.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把已归档会话提炼成可复用技能、会让过时事实退场的事实台账和主题簇；进行中的会话可只读增量提炼，记忆自检默认只测量不改写。注意：本机接口目前只检查 Host/Origin，尚未接入 DSH 宿主认证。

description.en: ★ 469 │ Build, run and interact with an iOS Simulator stream inside a conversation.
description.zh: ★ 469 │ 在会话中构建、运行并操作 iOS 模拟器画面。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Favorites, copy id and path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favorites filter for DSH conversations, as additive extensions to the shipped archive feature.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为已有归档功能增加收藏、筛选、复制 ID 和路径、单独删除及空闲时批量归档。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Provide Jina embeddings and reranking with reusable connections and DSH-managed credentials. Requires the @dsh-ai-providers/runtime bundle to be installed and activated; consumer plugins call the services.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过复用连接和 DSH 凭据提供 Jina 嵌入与重排序。需要先安装并启用 @dsh-ai-providers/runtime 组合包，由使用这些服务的插件调用。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Language control for tool-call descriptions, model thinking and replies: follow the GUI language, force one, or turn it off.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 控制工具说明、模型思考与回答所用的语言，可跟随界面或指定语言。

description.en: ★ 3 │ An agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Flash, matched by model id on any channel: the first turn offers only read, write, edit and the platform shell, and the full tool catalog opens after the first tool call. Delivered as a bundle patch, with no server routes.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 面向 DeepSeek V4 Flash 的智能体预设「探索模式」，按模型 id 命中、与渠道无关：首轮只给读、写、改和平台 shell，首次调用工具后放开全部工具。以 bundle 补丁交付，不开服务端接口。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Play workspace videos in the right-side document preview with seeking and native controls, including files above the RPC preview limit. Playback depends on browser codec support.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在右侧文档预览中播放工作区视频，支持原生控件和拖动进度，可读取超过 RPC 预览大小限制的文件。能否播放取决于浏览器编解码支持。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show OpenCode Go usage windows and reset times. The configured credential is sent to the usage endpoint, which defaults to opencode.ai.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 显示 OpenCode Go 各用量窗口和重置时间；所配置的凭据会发送至用量接口，默认地址为 opencode.ai。

description.en: ★ 3 │ dsh plugin: drive an existing dsh session from Feishu/Lark, with round cards, interactive resume, ask-user cards and steer (outbound-only WebSocket bot).
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 从飞书操作已有 DSH 会话，通过卡片查看轮次、回答问题、恢复任务或补充指令。

title.zh: 工作区状态与置顶通知

description.en: ★ 1 │ Workspace activity marks, a pinned-conversation section grouped by workspace, and notifications for pinned sessions. In-app notices are on and sound is off by default; OS notifications require permission and may show session titles. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 and Node >=22.18.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 显示工作区活动状态、按工作区分组的置顶会话及置顶状态通知。默认开启站内提示、关闭声音；系统通知需要授权，可能显示会话标题。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Node >=22.18。

description.en: ★ 24 │ One settings card for the iLife suite (memo, calories, cooking, home, schedule and bookkeeping), with a read-only config check and an update panel. Each skill is installed separately.
description.zh: ★ 24 │ 爱生活系列的统一设置卡，汇集备忘录、卡路里、私家大厨、居家管家、作息管家和记账六个技能，附只读配置体检和更新面板。各技能需单独安装。

description.en: ★ 2 │ DSH web plugin: monitors DeepSeek balance and platform usage, shown in the Models settings provider row and in the composer tool row to the left of the model name.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在模型设置和输入框工具栏显示 DeepSeek 余额与平台用量。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Back up the DSH desktop environment to a local Git repository and manage versions from Settings. Windows only; requires PowerShell, Git for Windows and initialization with setup.ps1. Export snapshots or copy a restore command; credentials are excluded by default.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把 DSH 桌面环境备份到本地 Git 仓库，在设置中管理版本、导出快照和复制恢复命令。仅适用于 Windows，需要 PowerShell、Git for Windows，并先用 setup.ps1 初始化备份仓库；凭据默认不备份。

description.en: ★ 1 │ TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web), offering $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 网页搜索和正文提取接入 TinyFish，支持直连或通过 Monid 调用。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Record a discussion with /cardex; afterwards a curation model turns it into linked Markdown knowledge cards, a knowledge tree and an offline HTML graph, with backlinks to the original Q&A. Recorded text goes to the chosen model (default: the session model) and costs tokens; the knowledge base is written to a configurable folder (default ~/journal/cardex). Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.19.0.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在会话中用 /cardex 记录讨论，结束后由整理模型生成可关联的 Markdown 知识卡片、知识树和离线 HTML 图谱，并保留原始问答回链。记录内容会发送给所选模型（默认当前会话模型）并产生费用；知识库写入可配置目录（默认 ~/journal/cardex）。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22.19.0。

description.en: ★ 76 │ Bring PUA to DSH: push the agent to change approach and verify results instead of giving up or declaring done too early, with persona styles, acceptance loops and status cards. Results depend on the model.
description.zh: ★ 76 │ 把 PUA 带到 DSH：在 Agent 反复失败、过早放弃或草率宣告完成时，引导它换方法、拿证据，提供多种风格、验收循环和状态卡片。效果取决于所用模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A sidebar pixel runner with jumping, sliding, token pickups and local scores. Runs in the web page; joins dsh-plugin-arcade when installed, otherwise provides its own sidebar entry.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 侧栏像素跑酷小游戏，支持跳跃、滑铲、收集 token 和本机记分。在网页中运行，装有 dsh-plugin-arcade 时归入游戏厅，否则提供独立侧栏入口。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Read and message independent DSH conversations across workspaces on the same host, with optional tool-level wake-up. Requires host Connection authentication; messages can start a new turn in the destination session.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在同一宿主的不同项目、目录会话之间查看内容和收发消息，可选工具级唤醒。需宿主提供 Connection 认证；投递消息可能启动目标会话的新一轮执行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill: create, edit and export PPT slides and presentations as local .pptx files with Pillow-rendered previews.
description.zh: 通过 kimi-ppt 技能创建、编辑和导出本地 .pptx 演示文稿，提供图片预览。

description.en: ★ 35 │ Cross-device sync for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a dedicated git mirror of the session store, append-only three-way merge with keep-both + fork conflict resolution, /sync command, sync_pull/sync_push/sync_status tools, and configurable auto push/pull
description.zh: ★ 35 │ 通过独立 Git 镜像同步会话，并处理合并与分支冲突。

description.en: ★ 1,015 │ Choose which Mnemon memory sources a strategy reads and which ones it may write. An optional add-on for Mnemon strategies.
description.zh: ★ 1,015 │ 指定 Mnemon 主策略读取哪些记忆来源、允许写入哪些，是 Mnemon 的可选扩展。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Lightweight to-do list for the DSH right sidebar: one item per line, check off to complete, collapsible completed items; stored locally, and the agent can add, check and delete via todo_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏逐项管理待办，勾选完成、折叠已完成项，支持 Agent 添加和修改。

description.en: ★ 0 │ View plugin health, configuration provenance and tool/MCP registrations; compatible hosts also support profile plugin controls. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 查看插件健康、配置来源和工具/MCP 注册信息；兼容的宿主还支持 profile 插件控制。未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage skills from a DSH Web sidebar page: view, edit, rename, import, export and enable or disable user skills; bundled and plugin-provided skills have limited actions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH Web 侧栏查看、编辑、重命名、导入导出和启停用户技能；随包附带或插件提供的技能仅开放相应查看与导出操作。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compare PNG edits against a mask and write heatmaps, HTML and SHA-256 reports locally. Uses RGBA8 comparison, including downconversion of 16-bit PNG samples.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在本地比对 PNG 蒙版外像素，生成热力图与证明报告；按 RGBA8 比较，16 位样本会降为 8 位。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Use your computer's DSH Web UI from a phone with Gitee or GitHub OAuth sign-in. Requires your own OAuth app, a fixed-domain tunnel and the package's postinstall script.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过 Gitee 或 GitHub OAuth 登录，在手机上使用电脑端 DSH Web。需自备 OAuth 应用和固定域名隧道，安装时需允许运行 postinstall 脚本。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage MCP servers in DSH Web with connection forms, JSON import, status groups and tool access through middleware.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH Web 中管理 MCP 服务器，支持连接表单、JSON 导入、按状态分组，并通过中间层调用工具。
