description.en: ★ 17 │ Show the current session's estimated cost, including subagents, below the input box using a maintained price table with aliases, peak/off-peak, holiday and long-context tiers. Figures are estimates at public token prices, not your actual bill. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 在输入框下方显示当前会话（含子代理）按公开 token 价格折算的费用，价格表支持别名、峰谷、节假日和长上下文阶梯。结果为估算，不代表实际账单。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: ★ 10,458 │ Connect SSH hosts with remote commands, terminals, SFTP and port forwarding.
description.zh: ★ 10,458 │ 连接 SSH 主机，使用远程命令、终端、SFTP 与端口转发。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Session Recap: writes session recaps in the background and gives the agent bounded progress checkpoints.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在后台生成会话摘要，记录阶段进度，供 Agent 后续继续工作。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Play configurable sounds for task completion, questions, approval and errors, with host-persisted settings and subagent filtering. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 and Node ^22.19 or >=24. Native playback uses Windows SoundPlayer, macOS afplay or Linux aplay; Codex/ZCode audio must be imported locally, with original synthesized tones included.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为任务完成、提问、授权和错误配置提示音，设置在宿主持久保存，可过滤子代理。需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 与 Node ^22.19 或 >=24；原生播放使用 Windows SoundPlayer、macOS afplay 或 Linux aplay，Codex/ZCode 音频需本机另行导入，包内包含原创合成音。

description.en: ★ 1 │ DSH todo floating ball: a draggable widget showing live progress of the session's todo_write list (total, done, in progress), with click to expand and status colours. Works on desktop and web.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用可拖动悬浮球显示待办总数、完成数和进行中任务，点击可展开清单。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show OpenCode GO monthly model limits in the model picker, using its public documentation and a cached fallback.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在模型选择器显示 OpenCode GO 各模型的月度额度，读取公开文档并在失败时使用缓存。

description.en: ★ 2 │ dsh plugin: keeps llm-pi-ai provider routes' model lists in step with the pi.dev gateway, written through the official settings seam.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 同步 pi.dev 网关模型列表，通过 DSH 设置更新 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置。

description.en: ★ 63 │ Answers from the current context in an independent bubble, without running tools.
description.zh: ★ 63 │ 根据当前上下文在独立气泡中回答旁支问题，不调用工具。

description.en: ★ 29 │ A read-only mirror for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: capability inventory with evidence, cross-plugin conflicts, a diff of what changed since the last scan, and an upgrade preflight that tells you which profiles still boot on a newer DSH
description.zh: ★ 29 │ 只读查看已安装插件的能力、冲突和版本差异，附源码位置及升级前检查。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Reusable roles for DSH's native Agent Team: per-role prompt, model and reasoning effort, model fallback chain, tool allowlist and Skills; the main agent starts members or continues the same member's conversation. description.en: ★ 0 │ Check local JSON/YAML canteen retention records against the bundled rules and list missing fields, literal differences and skipped checks for human review. Does not issue a compliance decision. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按随包规则核对本地 JSON/YAML 食堂留样台账，列出缺项、字面差异及无法执行的检查，供人工复核，不作合规认定。需 DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

title.zh: DSH 小程序内容目录检查

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check WeChat mini-program content catalogs, integer fen amounts, render usage and images. Fixes are dry-run by default; applying replaces the selected catalog file.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 检查微信小程序内容目录、整数分金额、价格渲染和图片路径；默认只预览，应用修复会重写所选目录文件。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compare local JSON/YAML safety qualification and training records with bundled rules, returning literal discrepancies and skipped checks for human review. Does not certify qualifications or compliance. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按随包规则核对本地 JSON/YAML 安全资格与培训台账，输出字面差异及无法执行的检查，供人工复核，不认定资质或合规性。需 DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Record local model usage and compare estimated costs with manually entered bills. Built-in prices are dated snapshots; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 记录本地模型用量，将费用估算与手工账单对照。内置价格是带日期的快照；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Inspect desktop screens and applications, then use approval-gated mouse and keyboard tools.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 查看桌面画面与应用，使用需要审批的鼠标和键盘操作工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Generate evidence-based delivery receipts through ship_receipt. Supplied check commands run as the current user by default; use run:false to record reported results. Requires Git and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 ship_receipt 生成带证据的交付回执。传入的检查命令默认按当前用户权限运行，run:false 仅记录转述结果。需 Git 与 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 30 │ Snapshot sessions, workspaces and configuration, compare changes and restore a checkpoint.
description.zh: ★ 30 │ 保存会话、工作区和配置快照，查看差异并一键回退。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Collect Git, artifact and secret-scan evidence for a delivery report. Configured test/build shell commands run by default on generation; use trusted projects or set runCommands:false. Requires Node >=20 and Git.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 收集 Git、产物与密钥扫描证据生成交付报告。生成时默认执行配置的测试/构建 shell 命令；仅用于可信项目，或设置 runCommands:false。需 Node >=20 与 Git。

description.en: ★ 28 │ Index local documents for hybrid search, context retrieval and citation checks.
description.zh: ★ 28 │ 为本地文档建立索引，进行混合检索、上下文召回与引用检查。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Generate launch SVG/HTML and bilingual copy from local repository facts. Choose a dedicated output directory; generation writes and can replace its named artifacts.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 从本地 README 和包信息生成发布 SVG、HTML 与双语文案；请使用独立输出目录，生成会覆盖同名产物。

description.en: ★ 28 │ Apply detection rules to messages, tool arguments and results, with auditable allow, ask or block decisions.
description.zh: ★ 28 │ 对消息、工具参数与结果应用检测规则，记录允许、询问或阻止的决策。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Generate Chinese changelogs from local Git history and optional session evidence. Requires Git and Node >=22; CLI file export is optional and model translation is not used.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 从本地 Git 历史与可选会话证据生成中文变更日志。需 Git 与 Node >=22；CLI 可选写出文件，不调用模型翻译。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Local-model (Ollama) integration for DeepSeek Harness: discover, pull, remove, and inspect local models, route requests to them by task type or keyword with automatic fallback to the cloud, and get a one-shot status overview via /ollama.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 发现和管理本地模型，按任务路由调用，并可回退到云端模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compose local PNG screenshots into README WebM/GIF and a cover image. Requires a separately installed ffmpeg; rebuilds replace generated artifacts and the output .frames directory.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把本地 PNG 截图合成为 README WebM、GIF 和封面；需自行安装 ffmpeg，重建会覆盖产物并清理输出 .frames 目录。

description.en: ★ 32 │ Four-source migration wizard: copy Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions — copy-only, approval-gated, idempotent
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 预览并复制多种编程助手的会话、记忆、技能与指令到 DSH。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show a pet indicator driven by real DSH agent/tool events. Activity stays in host memory; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用真实 DSH 智能体与工具事件驱动宠物状态提示。活动状态仅保存在宿主内存；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check aquaculture input records, including required fields, withdrawal periods and harvest date intervals.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对养殖投入品记录的字段、休药期与起捕日期间隔，提示记录差异。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compare local PNG screenshots and keep pixel-diff reports. Retains input images by default, with no direct external upload; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 比较本地 PNG 截图并保留像素差异报告。默认保留输入图，不直接上传外部服务；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check chapter, heading and subheading prefixes against declared commodity codes, reporting structural differences.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对章、品目、子目与商品编号的前缀和层级关系，提示结构差异。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add a heuristic/model review before selected destructive or sensitive tool calls. Review failures allow the existing host chain to continue; it is not a fail-closed security sandbox and consumes model quota.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在部分高风险工具调用前增加模型辅助审查；审查失败时继续原有宿主流程，会消耗模型额度，不能代替审批或沙箱。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check worksheet fields and consistency between process parameters, guide words and declared deviations.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对 HAZOP 表的要素，以及工艺参数、引导词与所填偏差的一致性。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check application structure and potential identity disclosures in document text and metadata using supplied rosters and rules.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 依据提供的名单和规则，核对基金申请结构及正文、文档属性中的潜在身份泄露。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Checks repair-order settlement arithmetic: confirms that project amounts, parts and labor hours, and the settlement total are internally consistent; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对维修工单中的项目金额、配件、工时和结算总额，仅提示算术差异。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Check rubric fields, evidence locations, per-item score limits and agreement between item scores and totals.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 核对评分项、原文定位、单项分值上限，以及各项得分与总分的算术一致性。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Recalculate energy loss, loss rates and meter totals, reporting arithmetic differences against declared figures.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 重算线损电量、线损率和计量点合计，提示与填报数值的算术差异。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Checks 三重一大 decision ledgers against prior research, meeting deliberation and resolution records; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 依据前置研究、会议审议与决议记录程序，核对“三重一大”决策台账并留痕；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check overdue days against dates and free periods, and compare declared charges with days multiplied by rates.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按日期与免箱期核对超期天数，并比较填报费用与天数乘费率的结果。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check archive registers for required fields, duplicate identifiers, retention terms and transfer dates.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对档案台账的必填字段、重复档号、保管期限用词和移交日期。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Checks tender-document clause excerpts against the original text, verifying completeness by source and verbatim wording; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 依据出处与原文逐字核对招标文件条款摘录的完整性；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Connect WorkBuddy desktop models through the Functy fork, with a dashboard, account rotation and quota display.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 通过 Functy 分支接入 WorkBuddy 桌面模型，提供仪表盘、账号轮换和额度显示。
